paper.title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
paper.abstract: Agentic memory is becoming essential for long-horizon AI agents, yet many existing systems rely on autoregressive LLMs to control how memories are organized, retrieved, and used, placing expensive generation on the critical path of memory operations. summary.core_problem: 该工作解决的是长时程 LLM agent 的记忆控制成本问题：记忆系统需要频繁决定存什么、怎么连、查哪里、查多少、何时停止，如果这些决策都交给自回归 LLM 生成，会把记忆操作变成延迟和成本瓶颈。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 agent memory 系统，不是基座预训练论文。它对预训练研究的启发在于控制平面和推理平面的分离：并不是所有语义决策都需要由大模型生成 token 来完成。对于长上下文、外部记忆、持续学习接口，这个思路有参考意义。高频、结构化、低熵的决策可以用轻量分类式或概率式控制器处理，把自回归模型留给证据综合和最终回答。这个取舍也提醒预训练研究者：长程能力不只来自更长 context，检索、路由、停止策略和记忆结构同样会决定实际可用性。
summary.technical_approach: Jev-Mem 将 agentic memory 拆成三层：System-One control plane、structured memory data plane、System-Two reasoning plane。System One 负责快速、结构化、非自回归的控制决策；System Two 负责慢速的语义综合和回答生成。写入路径上，System One 做 memory typing、冗余过滤，以及语义、时间、因果、实体关系的构建。读取路径上，它做 query routing、retrieval budget allocation、graph traversal、候选记忆打分、证据评估和 adaptive stopping。中间的 memory plane 不是简单向量库，而是多关系结构化记忆，支持沿实体、时间、因果和语义边检索。与常见 RAG/agent memory 的区别在于，Jev-Mem 不把每个控制步骤都放进 LLM prompt 中让模型生成，而是把这些高频决策显式做成一个控制层。Jev TypeSafe AI 被用作一个具体实现，提供 typed probabilistic decisions，但架构重点是轻量控制和生成推理的职责切分。
summary.experiments: 给定内容中只给出总体结论：Jev-Mem 在若干 agentic memory 基线中取得更高的整体准确率，同时推理效率也更好。根据方法描述，实验应主要比较三类指标：任务准确率、记忆检索质量，以及端到端成本/延迟或自回归调用次数。关键消融应包括：去掉 System-One 控制器、用固定启发式替代控制器、用 LLM 控制所有记忆操作、去掉多关系图结构、关闭 adaptive stopping。完整数字未出现在给定材料中，阅读时需要核对效率收益是否来自减少 LLM 调用，还是来自更小检索集合；也要看准确率提升是否稳定覆盖多轮任务，而不是集中在某个特定 benchmark。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看系统架构图和 memory lifecycle，确认写入、组织、读取、停止分别由谁负责。然后看 System-One 控制器的实现细节：输入特征是什么，输出类型有哪些，是否需要训练，错误如何传播。实验部分重点看延迟、token 成本、LLM 调用次数和准确率之间的 trade-off。若时间有限，可以跳过认知心理学动机，直接看 write path、read path 和 ablation。对基座研究者，最有用的问题是：哪些 agent 记忆决策可以从自回归生成改成 typed decision，这是否能作为长上下文训练和外部记忆系统之间的接口设计参考。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the control cost of long-horizon agent memory. Persistent agents must repeatedly decide what to store, how to connect memories, where to retrieve, how much evidence to read, and when to stop. If each of these decisions is handled by an autoregressive LLM, memory management itself becomes a latency and inference-cost bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory systems paper rather than a base pretraining paper. Its relevance to LLM researchers lies in the separation between a control plane and a reasoning plane. Many memory operations are frequent, structured, and low-entropy; they do not necessarily require token-by-token generation. A lightweight controller can handle routing, typing, scoring, and stopping, while the LLM is reserved for synthesis and final response generation. This is also relevant to long-context modeling: usable long-horizon behavior depends not only on context length, but also on indexing, retrieval structure, routing, and stopping policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Jev-Mem proposes a three-plane architecture: a System-One control plane, a structured memory data plane, and a System-Two reasoning plane. The System-One controller makes fast typed probabilistic decisions without autoregressive generation. On the write path, it performs memory typing, redundancy filtering, and construction of semantic, temporal, causal, and entity relations. On the read path, it performs query routing, retrieval-budget allocation, graph traversal, candidate scoring, evidence assessment, and adaptive stopping. The memory plane is a multi-relational store rather than a flat vector database. The System-Two LLM is used for deliberative reasoning and answer generation after evidence has been selected. The main distinction from typical RAG-style or agent-memory systems is that high-frequency memory-control operations are not repeatedly pushed into LLM prompts; they are exposed as a separate control layer.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content reports that Jev-Mem achieves higher overall accuracy and better efficiency than contemporary memory baselines, but it does not include the full numerical tables. The important evaluation axes should be task accuracy, retrieval quality, end-to-end latency, token cost, and the number of autoregressive LLM calls. The most informative ablations would compare the full system against fixed heuristics, LLM-controlled memory operations, removal of the System-One controller, removal of multi-relational structure, and removal of adaptive stopping. When reading the results, the key question is whether the efficiency gain comes from fewer LLM calls, smaller retrieved contexts, or both, and whether accuracy remains stable across multi-step tasks rather than improving on a narrow benchmark slice.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take about 25–35 minutes. Focus first on the architecture diagram and the memory lifecycle: write, organize, retrieve, score, and stop. Then inspect the System-One controller: its inputs, output types, training or calibration procedure, and how errors affect downstream reasoning. In the experiments, prioritize the accuracy–latency–cost trade-off and the ablation table. The cognitive framing can be read lightly. For base-model researchers, the useful takeaway is the design pattern: convert repeated memory-control decisions from autoregressive generation into typed decisions, and keep generation for evidence synthesis.

recommendation.zh: 将System 1/2思想引入Agent记忆管理，通过解耦检索控制与复杂推理来降低LLM调用成本，对设计高效Agent架构有启发。
recommendation.en: Introduces System 1/2 thinking to agent memory management, decoupling retrieval control from complex reasoning to reduce LLM invocation costs, inspiring efficient agent architecture design.

paper.title: IntBMoE: Integrating Block-Level Conditioning into Expert Composition for Full-Participation Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales capacity, but existing designs cannot set three quantities independently. For a single token, participation is how many experts contribute knowledge to its output, execution is how many are actually computed (compute cost), and materialization is how many expert-sized parameter sets must be built and stored (memory cost). Sparse routing keeps execution and materialization low, but shrinks participation: for each token, only a few experts contribute. Dense output-m

summary.core_problem: IntBMoE 解决的是 MoE 中三个量被耦合的问题：每个 token 能从多少专家受益，实际要执行多少专家，以及运行时要物化多少专家参数。现有稀疏路由、稠密输出混合、参数合并分别只能优化其中一部分。论文希望让全专家参与、稀疏执行、受控内存同时成立。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 LLM 预训练架构的启发主要在 MoE 设计空间。它把 MoE 的代价拆成 participation、execution、materialization 三个维度，比只讨论 top-k 激活专家数更清楚。对大规模 MoE 来说，瓶颈不只是 FLOPs，也包括路由粒度、专家组合参数的物化成本、以及非激活专家是否能得到学习信号。IntBMoE 的贡献是提出一种“先由全专家池合成少量可复用 block，再让 token 稀疏选择 block”的方案。它不是直接替代 Switch/GShard/DeepSeekMoE 这类 token-to-expert 路由，但提供了一个可分析的中间形态：全专家知识参与可以和稀疏 token 执行解耦。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的核心是 block-level conditioning。模型维护一个小的 learned codebook，每个 code embedding 对应一个可复用 block。共享 hypernetwork 按层生成这些 block 的参数：对每一层，它根据 code embedding 将专家基底组合成一个 composed expert。这样，每个 block 的构造已经汇聚了完整专家池的信息；token 推理时不再直接路由到原始专家，而是由 router 选择少量 block 执行。结果是：participation 由组合时使用的完整专家池决定，execution 由 token 选择的 top-k block 数决定，materialization 由 codebook 大小决定。

论文还引入 Dual-Path Residual Gating。它不是只把专家基底线性合并成一个单路径 FFN，而是分别构造 value path 和 gate path，再通过门控乘积形成非线性组合。这样可以提升专家组合的表达力，同时不增加原始专家池规模。和稀疏 MoE 相比，IntBMoE 避免了非选中专家完全不参与当前 token 输出的问题；和稠密 MoE 相比，它不需要对每个 token 执行所有专家；和 token/segment 级参数合并相比，它不需要为每个路由单元都生成一套独立专家参数。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 ImageNet-1K、语言建模、序列推荐和线上推荐系统。论文报告在 ImageNet-1K 上相对代表性的稀疏 MoE 与稠密 MoE baseline 有稳定提升；语言建模和序列推荐结果用于验证该结构不只适用于视觉输入。工程侧结果更有信息量：IntBMoE 已部署到 AMap 的生成式推荐系统，在 60 ms 延迟约束下服务数亿用户，线上 A/B 得到 2.4% 相对 UVCTR 提升。这个结果说明 bounded materialization 不只是理论复杂度指标，在实际低延迟系统里会直接影响可部署性。精读时需要查看具体实验表，尤其是不同 codebook size、token top-k、DPRG 开关、专家数变化时的精度和延迟曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 introduction 中对 participation、execution、materialization 的定义，这部分是论文最清楚的贡献。然后看方法章节中 codebook、shared hypernetwork、block router 的计算流程，确认 block 是如何由专家基底构造出来的。DPRG 小节值得单独看，它决定了该方法是否只是线性参数合并的变体。实验部分重点看消融表：codebook 大小、每个 token 选择的 block 数、DPRG、专家池规模、不同任务上的迁移。对 LLM 预训练研究员来说，最值得深挖的是训练动态：全专家通过 block 组合获得梯度，是否真的缓解专家饥饿；block codebook 是否会塌缩；以及在大规模 decoder-only MoE 中通信和参数物化是否仍可控。

summary_en.core_problem: IntBMoE targets a structural coupling in MoE layers: how many experts contribute to a token, how many experts are executed, and how many expert-sized parameter sets must be materialized at runtime. Sparse routing, dense output mixing, and parameter merging each optimize only part of this trade-off. The paper aims to obtain full-pool participation, sparse execution, and bounded materialization at the same time.
summary_en.importance: The main value for LLM pretraining is architectural. The paper gives a useful decomposition of MoE cost into participation, execution, and materialization, which is more informative than counting activated experts alone. At large scale, MoE cost is not only FLOPs; routing granularity, parameter synthesis, and whether inactive experts receive learning signal also matter. IntBMoE proposes an intermediate design: compose a small set of reusable blocks from the full expert pool, then let tokens sparsely select among those blocks. This does not directly replace standard token-to-expert routing, but it expands the design space for MoE layers where full expert participation and sparse token computation are separated.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method uses block-level conditioning. A learned codebook defines a bounded set of block embeddings. A shared hypernetwork uses each code embedding to construct block parameters layer by layer by merging the underlying expert bases. Each constructed block therefore already contains information from the full expert pool. During token processing, a router selects only a small number of these blocks for each token. Participation is controlled by full-pool composition, execution is controlled by the number of selected blocks, and materialization is bounded by the codebook size.

The paper also introduces Dual-Path Residual Gating. Instead of merging expert bases into a single linear path, it composes separate value and gate paths and combines them through a gated product. This gives the composed expert a nonlinear dependence on expert bases without increasing the number of raw experts. Compared with sparse MoE, non-selected raw experts can still influence a token through block composition. Compared with dense MoE, the model avoids executing all experts per token. Compared with per-token or per-segment parameter merging, it avoids materializing a new expert-sized parameter set for every routing unit.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers ImageNet-1K, language modeling, sequential recommendation, and a production recommendation system. The paper reports consistent gains over representative sparse and dense MoE baselines on ImageNet-1K. Language modeling and recommendation experiments are used to test whether the same structure transfers beyond vision. The deployment result is particularly relevant: IntBMoE is reported to run in AMap’s generative recommendation system under a 60 ms latency budget, serving hundreds of millions of users, with a 2.4% relative UVCTR gain in online A/B testing. The key experimental details to inspect are the curves for codebook size, token top-k over blocks, the DPRG ablation, expert-pool size, and latency or materialization cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 25–35 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and the definitions of participation, execution, and materialization; that is the cleanest part of the contribution. Then read the method sections covering the codebook, shared hypernetwork, and block router to understand how blocks are constructed from expert bases. The DPRG section is worth reading separately because it determines whether the method is more than a linear parameter-merging variant. In the experiments, focus on ablations over codebook size, selected blocks per token, DPRG, and expert count. For LLM pretraining, the open questions are training dynamics: whether full-pool composition gives healthier gradients to experts, whether the block codebook collapses, and whether communication and parameter materialization remain manageable in large decoder-only MoE training.

recommendation.zh: 解耦 MoE 的参与度、计算和内存成本是个好思路，通过超网络动态合并专家基底的方案值得关注，但需看实际训练稳定性和推理开销。
recommendation.en: Decoupling participation, compute, and memory in MoE is a strong direction; the hypernetwork-based dynamic merging is worth noting, though training stability and inference overhead need verification.

paper.title: Understanding LLM Quantization through Activation-Guided Compensation and Orthogonal Residuals
paper.abstract: Post-training weight-activation quantization reduces the memory and inference costs of large language models, but aggressive W4A4 quantization remains difficult because activation outliers degrade effective quantization resolution. Although weight optimization, channel-wise scaling, and orthogonal rotation mitigate this problem, the error components they address and their relationship remain unclear. summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 W4A4 post-training quantization 中的局部误差结构，核心问题是区分哪些量化误差可以通过权重量化补偿修正，哪些误差必须通过旋转、缩放等激活空间变换来降低。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和预训练本身不是直接同一层问题，但对基座模型压缩和部署有清晰启发。低比特量化失败常被归因于 activation outlier，但不同方法处理的是不同误差项：GPTQ 类方法优化权重，SmoothQuant 类方法做通道缩放，QuaRot/SpinQuant 类方法做正交旋转。论文给出一个统一的局部误差分解，把这些操作的作用边界讲清楚。它的贡献类型偏分析和配置原则，不是单纯提出一个新的量化 recipe。对训练侧也有间接价值：如果某些激活异常结构会形成权重补偿无法消除的 orthogonal residual，那么量化友好的预训练可能需要控制激活分布、归一化位置和通道异常持续性。
summary.technical_approach:
论文从单个线性层出发，设全精度输出为 Y = XW^T。对输入通道施加可逆变换 P，得到 Z = XP、V = WP^{-T}，保持全精度输出不变，但改变激活和权重进入量化器时的坐标系。激活量化采用 per-token symmetric uniform quantization，动态 scale 由每个 token 的 ||Z_t||_∞ 决定；若是 4-bit 激活，q_A = 2^{4-1}-1 = 7。权重量化器不限定为普通 rounding，可以是 GPTQ 等优化后的量化权重。

核心分析是把局部 weight-activation quantization error 精确分解为两部分：activation-guided weight compensation 和 orthogonal residual。前者是权重量化优化可以沿着激活方向补偿的误差；后者与可补偿子空间正交，固定变换 P 后无法再靠权重优化消除。这个分解把“权重补偿”和“表示变换”分开了：前者负责在给定坐标系内拟合输出，后者负责改变残差结构。

进一步分析 orthogonal residual 后，论文解释了三类常见设计。随机正交旋转可以摊平 persistent channel-wise outlier 对 per-token 量化 scale 的影响；sign selection 可以降低异常结构与旋转基之间的不利对齐；channel scaling 需要在 activation-side 和 weight-side 量之间取平衡。论文从 regular activation quantity 的二阶矩 bound 出发，推导出一个 L2 scaling rule，并说明 SmoothQuant 风格的 L∞ scaling 可以看作进一步放松后的形式。
summary.experiments: 实验检验的是理论指导下的 backpropagation-free 配置，而不是训练一个新的量化变换。配置包括 signed online Hadamard rotation、基于 calibration 的 sign selection、以及 L2 channel scaling。论文在 8 个 Llama 和 Mistral 模型上评估 W4A4 量化，报告其性能可以接近需要梯度训练的 SpinQuant。关键观察是：旋转、符号选择、缩放不是互相替代的技巧，而是分别作用在 orthogonal residual 的不同结构上。文中给出的数字层面信息包括 W4A4 设置、per-token 4-bit 激活量化下 q_A = 7、以及 8 个 Llama/Mistral 模型的覆盖范围。具体 perplexity、zero-shot accuracy 和各模型尺寸的差值需要看实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–40 分钟。先看 Problem Setting，确认 P 变换如何保持 XW^T 不变，以及激活量化 scale 为什么由 ||Z_t||_∞ 控制。然后看 error decomposition 的定理和证明，重点是 AGWC 与 orthogonal residual 的定义，以及为什么固定 P 后权重优化只能处理前者。再看 residual bound，它连接 persistent outlier、regular activation 和旋转/缩放设计。实验部分可快速看主表和消融：Hadamard rotation、sign selection、L2 scaling 分别带来什么变化。对预训练研究更有用的是分析部分，而不是具体量化分数；它提示低比特部署问题可能要在模型训练阶段就关注激活异常的持续性和通道尺度分布。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the local error structure of W4A4 post-training quantization. Its central question is which part of the weight-activation quantization error can be compensated by optimizing quantized weights, and which part must be reduced by changing the activation coordinate system through rotations or scaling.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for base-model compression and deployment. Low-bit quantization failures are often attributed to activation outliers, while different methods address different pieces of the problem: GPTQ-style methods optimize weights, SmoothQuant-style methods rescale channels, and QuaRot or SpinQuant-style methods rotate activations. The paper provides a unified local error decomposition that clarifies the boundary between these operations. Its contribution is mainly analytical and prescriptive: it explains how to configure existing quantization tools rather than introducing a completely new quantizer. It also has an indirect training implication: if some activation-outlier structures create an orthogonal residual that weight compensation cannot remove, quantization-aware pretraining may need to control activation distributions, normalization behavior, and persistent channel outliers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The analysis starts from one linear layer, Y = XW^T. An invertible transformation P is inserted as Z = XP and V = WP^{-T}, preserving the full-precision output while changing the coordinates seen by activation and weight quantizers. Activation quantization is modeled as per-token symmetric uniform quantization with a dynamic scale determined by ||Z_t||_∞. For 4-bit activations, q_A = 2^{4-1}-1 = 7. The weight quantizer is left general; it may be standard rounding or an optimized method such as GPTQ.

The key result is an exact decomposition of the local weight-activation quantization error into an activation-guided weight compensation term and an orthogonal residual. The first term is the part that weight optimization can reduce along directions supported by the quantized activations. The second term is orthogonal to that compensatable subspace; once P is fixed, it cannot be removed by better weight compensation. This separates two roles that are often mixed together: weight optimization fits the output within a chosen coordinate system, while transformations change the residual structure before quantization.

The paper then analyzes the orthogonal residual to explain common design choices. Random orthogonal rotations reduce the impact of persistent channel-wise outliers on per-token quantization scales. Sign selection reduces unfavorable alignment between outlier structure and the rotation basis. Channel scaling balances activation-side and weight-side quantities. From a second-moment bound on the regular activation term, the paper derives an L2 scaling rule and relates SmoothQuant-like L∞ scaling to a further relaxation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate backpropagation-free configurations guided by the analysis, rather than a newly trained quantization transform. The tested components include signed online Hadamard rotation, calibration-based sign selection, and L2 channel scaling. The paper evaluates W4A4 quantization across eight Llama and Mistral models and reports performance competitive with gradient-trained SpinQuant. The main empirical message is that rotation, sign selection, and scaling are complementary: they affect different structures inside the orthogonal residual. The concrete numerical details available from the text include the W4A4 setting, q_A = 7 for signed 4-bit per-token activation quantization, and coverage over eight Llama/Mistral models. Exact perplexity, zero-shot accuracy, and model-size-specific deltas should be read from the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 30–40 minutes. Start with the problem setup to verify how the P transformation preserves XW^T and why per-token activation scales depend on ||Z_t||_∞. Then read the error decomposition theorem and proof, focusing on the definitions of AGWC and the orthogonal residual, and on why weight optimization cannot reduce the residual once P is fixed. The residual bound is the most useful analytical part because it connects persistent outliers, regular activations, rotations, and scaling. In the experiments, read the main table and ablations for Hadamard rotation, sign selection, and L2 scaling. For pretraining researchers, the analysis is more useful than the final quantization scores: it suggests that persistent activation outliers and channel-scale imbalance may need to be considered during model training if aggressive low-bit deployment is a target.

recommendation.zh: 对 W4A4 量化误差的理论分解很漂亮，解释了 Hadamard 旋转等 trick 为什么 work，做量化和推理优化的同学值得一看。
recommendation.en: The theoretical decomposition of W4A4 quantization error is elegant and explains why tricks like Hadamard rotation work; worth reading for those working on quantization and inference optimization.

paper.title: StackTok: Accelerating VLMs Inference with Budget-Adaptive Visual Token Selection
paper.abstract: Increasing image resolution produces ever-longer visual-token sequences in vision-language models (VLMs), substantially raising their inference cost. To reduce this overhead without retraining, existing methods select compact token subsets that prioritize query relevance, visual coverage, or a fixed trade-off between them. The appropriate balance, however, varies across queries and token budgets: localized questions favor relevance, whereas holistic questions demand broader visual coverage. We i

summary.core_problem: 解决高分辨率输入下 VLM 视觉 token 序列过长、推理成本快速上升的问题，且希望在不重训模型的前提下自适应压缩视觉 token。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的 VLM 工作，贡献是训练后、免重训的 budget-adaptive visual token selection。对做多模态基座的人有一定参考，但不直接推进预训练方法论。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StackTok：把 query relevance 作为主目标，把 visual coverage 作为随预算变化的辅助约束。方法先构建仅覆盖驱动的 size-indexed reference，再用 query-vision affinity entropy 估计当前问题更偏局部还是全局，最后通过 reference-gated interleaved selection 在 relevance-oriented 与 coverage-oriented 选 token 之间切换。对高分辨率图像还采用分块式分配策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但实验应在高分辨率 VLM 推理场景中，与现有训练后 token selection 方法比较，在不同 token budget 下权衡速度与精度。核心看点是是否在 localized questions 与 holistic questions 两类查询上都更稳。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the inference-cost explosion in VLMs caused by long visual-token sequences from high-resolution images, aiming to reduce tokens adaptively without retraining.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper for VLMs. Its contribution is a training-free, budget-adaptive visual token selector. It is somewhat useful for multimodal foundation-model researchers, but it does not directly advance pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: StackTok treats query relevance as the main objective and visual coverage as a budget-dependent support signal. It builds a size-indexed coverage reference from a coverage-only greedy sequence, estimates whether a query is local or holistic via query-vision affinity entropy, and uses a reference-gated interleaved policy to alternate between relevance-oriented and coverage-oriented token additions. It also includes chunk-wise allocation for high-resolution inputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but experiments likely compare against prior post-hoc token selection methods on high-resolution VLM inference under different token budgets, with the key question being robustness across localized versus holistic queries.

recommendation.zh: 是个像样的后处理推理技巧，但不必高估；只看“entropy 决定 relevance/coverage 权衡”这件事，若做高分辨率 VLM serving 可顺手复现。
recommendation.en: A reasonable post-hoc inference trick, but not a deep idea; focus on the entropy-based relevance/coverage trade-off if you care about high-res VLM serving.

paper.title: Lightning Weave: Improving the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier of Reasoning Models through Capability Composition
paper.abstract: A core goal of efficient reasoning is to improve the accuracy-efficiency frontier. However, jointly improving reasoning accuracy and inference efficiency can be challenging, as the two objectives can favor different reasoning behaviors. Independently post-trained models already offer distinct strengths in accuracy and efficiency. We introduce Lightning Weave, a post-training framework that extracts and composes these independently learned capabilities in a single student through on-policy distil

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是推理模型里一个很实际的矛盾：高准确率往往伴随更长的 reasoning trace，而压缩输出长度又容易伤害正确率。作者不直接联合优化“又准又短”，而是换了一个角度：既然不同 post-training 已经分别学出了准确性和效率两类能力，能不能把这些能力从各自 specialist 中抽出来，再组合进一个 student，得到更好的 accuracy–efficiency frontier。核心难点不在多教师蒸馏本身，而在如何把不同 specialist 的行为增量表示成可组合、可离线训练、且目标稳定的监督信号。
summary.importance: 它主要属于 post-training 和 reasoning distillation，不是预训练论文。但对基座研究仍有两点启发。第一，它把“能力”表示成 post-training 前后策略的 log-ratio shift，而不是直接模仿最终 teacher，这种表示更接近把训练增量模块化，未来可以迁移到 continual pretrain、mid-training annealing、RL 后能力注入等场景。第二，它认真处理了 offline on-policy distillation 的目标漂移问题：缓存轨迹上的 surrogate loss 如果没有显式 stationary target，student 学到后期会被错误梯度继续推走。这一点对任何离线蒸馏、缓存式 RLHF/RLAIF、甚至部分预训练数据重加权方法都有方法论价值。若关注 pretrain↔post-train 接口，这篇比一般 reasoning 蒸馏更值得看。
summary.technical_approach:
方法从 on-policy distillation 出发，但关键不是普通 teacher-student KL，而是“能力组合”的表示方式。作者对每个 specialist 构造一个 anchor pair：一个是 post-training 前的基线模型，一个是经过某种专项训练后的 specialist。对于同一个 token state，specialist 相对 anchor-before 的 log probability ratio 被视为该专项训练带来的 policy shift。这样定义有两个好处。第一，它抽取的是增量能力，而不是把 teacher 的全部分布都搬过来，因此更容易和其他 specialist 的增量叠加。第二，它不要求不同教师参数同构，只要求能在 student 生成的状态上打分。

在多能力组合时，Lightning Weave先把不同 anchor pair 的 log-ratio shift 对齐到 student 的 token states 上，再做加权求和，得到一个联合 shift。这里的设计选择很重要：作者不是分别构造多个 target 再做混合，而是先组合 shift，再构造单一目标分布。这样所有能力源在每个 token 决策点上共同作用，避免后续 target averaging 带来的不一致。

真正的方法核心是 Tilted-Target DOPD。作者指出，若直接把 DOPD 的 sampled-token surrogate 用在缓存轨迹上，会出现 stationary target 不保真的问题。原因是缓存来自旧的 behavior policy，当 student 更新后，基于缓存 action 估计的 regularizer 不再等价于当前 student 相对目标策略的 KL；即使 student 已经到达理想 shifted policy，loss 仍可能非零，梯度也不会消失，训练会继续把模型推离目标。为了解决这个问题，作者让每个缓存 shift 显式“倾斜”冻结的 behavior policy，构造出一个明确的 tilted target distribution，然后最小化当前 student 到该 target 的 KL。这样做后，至少在缓存状态上，目标是静态且可达的：当 student 匹配 target 时，loss 和梯度都应消失。文中还强调，这个构造保留了 token-level DOPD surrogate 在初始阶段的期望更新方向，因此既继承了原方法的有效起步信号，又修复了离线训练后期的目标漂移。

工程上，这个框架把昂贵的多教师在线打分转成一次性缓存。若有 K 个 anchor pair，在线 OPD 需要每条 student rollout 经过最多 2K 个 anchor 模型评分；Lightning Weave则先对缓存轨迹离线打分，之后训练只依赖 student 和缓存分数。这样多能力组合的成本主要前置到数据准备阶段，训练期更接近普通离线蒸馏。

与已有多教师蒸馏相比，这篇工作的区别不只是“多加几个 teacher”，而是把 teacher 的贡献限制为可解释的 policy shift，并为离线组合提供了一个有明确定点的目标分布。与参数空间 merge 相比，它不要求模型结构或参数对齐；与直接监督最终 specialist 相比，它更容易调节不同能力的权重，形成一条可控的 trade-off 曲线。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖数学和代码两类推理场景，学生模型包括至少 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3.5-4B，评测涉及五个 benchmark。主设定是把 accuracy-oriented 的 Klear 与 efficiency-oriented 的 DECS 进行组合。结果上，Lightning Weave相对 base model 和单一 anchor 方案都改善了 accuracy–efficiency trade-off。

文中给出的几个关键数字比较清楚。对 Qwen3-4B，在 AIME 2024 上准确率从 72.9% 提升到 76.0%，同时响应 token 数减少 21.3%。对 Qwen3.5-4B，在 HMMT 2025 上准确率从 59.2% 提升到 64.0%，同时 token 数减少 10.7%；在 LiveCodeBench v5 上准确率从 41.7% 提升到 54.2%，同时 token 数减少 9.6%。这些结果说明它不是单纯用更长链路换准确率，也不是靠极端压缩换效率，而是在两者之间找到了更好的折中。

更值得注意的是权重扫描实验。作者通过调整不同 anchor 信号的相对强度，得到一族 student，形成经验上的 Pareto frontier。这一点支持了“能力可组合且可调”的主张，而不只是某个固定配方偶然有效。阅读实验时建议重点看三类消融：一是直接 DOPD 缓存目标与 Tilted-Target DOPD 的对比，验证 stationary target 的必要性；二是 compose-before-target 与其他组合方式的对比；三是不同 anchor 权重下准确率和 token 长度的曲线，而不是只看单点最优。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓住两个问题：能力如何表示，离线蒸馏为什么会目标漂移。Introduction 已经把动机讲得比较完整。Method 部分建议重点看 anchor-pair policy shift 的定义、Tilted-Target DOPD 的推导，以及多 anchor shift 如何在 shared student token states 上组合。若时间有限，可以先跳过部分公式细节，但要看清“为什么 cached sampled-token surrogate 在 student 变化后不再对应正确 KL”这一段，这是全文最关键的论证。

实验部分优先看主结果表和 trade-off 曲线，再看 ablation。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。如果要深挖，建议把它和 Direct On-Policy Distillation、Lightning OPD、以及参数 merge 类方法对照着读，重点比较它们各自如何定义 teacher signal、如何处理离线缓存、以及何时存在稳定定点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical tension in reasoning models: higher accuracy often comes with longer reasoning traces, while aggressively shortening outputs can damage correctness. Instead of jointly optimizing for both objectives from scratch, the authors ask whether independently post-trained specialists already contain complementary capabilities that can be extracted and recomposed into a single student. The hard part is not generic multi-teacher distillation. It is how to represent each specialist’s contribution as a composable policy increment, and how to make offline on-policy distillation stable once supervision is cached.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and reasoning-distillation paper rather than a pretraining one. Still, it has two useful implications for foundation-model research. First, it represents a learned capability as the policy shift induced by a post-training stage, measured relative to a pre-stage anchor checkpoint. That is a modular view of training increments, and it could matter for continual pretraining, mid-training annealing, or injecting RL-acquired behaviors back into a base model. Second, it directly tackles target drift in offline on-policy distillation. If cached trajectories are used with the wrong surrogate, the student can keep receiving non-zero gradients even after reaching the intended target policy. That lesson extends beyond reasoning distillation to cached preference optimization, offline RLHF-style pipelines, and other settings where supervision is precomputed.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method starts from on-policy distillation, but the key idea is how capabilities are encoded. For each specialist, the authors form an anchor pair: a checkpoint before the relevant post-training stage and the resulting specialist after that stage. At a shared token state, the log-probability ratio between the specialist and the pre-stage anchor is treated as the policy shift learned during post-training. This is a useful abstraction because it isolates the incremental behavior change rather than copying the specialist distribution wholesale, and it does not require parameter alignment across teachers.

For multi-capability composition, Lightning Weave aligns these log-ratio shifts on student-generated token states and takes a weighted sum to form a joint shift. Importantly, it composes shifts first and constructs a single target distribution afterward, rather than building separate targets and averaging them later. That means all capability sources jointly shape each student decision at the token level.

The main technical contribution is Tilted-Target DOPD. The paper argues that directly reusing DOPD’s sampled-token surrogate on cached trajectories does not preserve the intended stationary solution. The cache was generated under an older behavior policy, and once the student moves away from that policy, the sampled-action regularizer no longer matches the KL that should be imposed relative to the current student. As a result, even if the student reaches the desired shifted policy, the cached surrogate can still produce non-zero gradients and push the model away from the solution. To fix this, each cached shift is used to explicitly tilt the frozen behavior policy into a target distribution, and training minimizes KL from the current student to that explicit target. This gives the offline objective a proper fixed point: when the student matches the target on cached states, both loss and gradient vanish. The paper also argues that this construction preserves the expected initial update direction of token-level DOPD, so it keeps the useful early-stage signal while repairing the late-stage mismatch.

From a systems perspective, the framework converts expensive online multi-teacher scoring into a one-time offline caching step. With K anchor pairs, naive online OPD may require up to 2K anchor-model evaluations per student rollout. Lightning Weave scores cached trajectories once and then trains using only the student and cached scores.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover both math and code reasoning, with student models including at least Qwen3-4B and Qwen3.5-4B, evaluated on five benchmarks. The main setting composes an accuracy-oriented shift from Klear with an efficiency-oriented shift from DECS. The reported results show consistent improvements in the accuracy–efficiency trade-off over both the base model and single-anchor alternatives.

The clearest numbers are as follows. On Qwen3-4B, Lightning Weave improves AIME 2024 accuracy from 72.9% to 76.0% while reducing response tokens by 21.3%. On Qwen3.5-4B, it improves HMMT 2025 accuracy from 59.2% to 64.0% with 10.7% fewer tokens, and LiveCodeBench v5 accuracy from 41.7% to 54.2% with 9.6% fewer tokens. These are meaningful because the gains are not coming from simply allowing longer traces, nor from sacrificing too much accuracy for brevity.

The weight-sweep results are also important. By varying the relative strengths of the anchor signals, the method produces a family of students that trace out an empirical Pareto frontier. That supports the claim that capabilities are genuinely composable and tunable, rather than the method working only at one lucky operating point. The most important ablations to inspect are the comparison between direct cached DOPD and Tilted-Target DOPD, the effect of composing shifts before target construction, and the trade-off curves under different anchor weights.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on two questions: how capability is represented, and why offline distillation drifts without an explicit target. The introduction already frames both well. In the method section, prioritize the definition of anchor-pair policy shifts, the derivation of Tilted-Target DOPD, and the multi-anchor composition rule on shared student token states. If time is limited, you can skip some algebra, but do not skip the argument for why the cached sampled-token surrogate ceases to correspond to the intended KL once the student changes. That is the central technical point.

In the experiments, read the main result tables and the trade-off curves first, then the ablations. A solid skim should take around 30–45 minutes. For deeper study, it is useful to compare this paper against Direct On-Policy Distillation, Lightning OPD, and parameter-merging approaches, with attention to how each method defines teacher signal, handles offline caches, and whether the training objective has a stable fixed point.

recommendation.zh: 读方法部分即可；把能力建模成相对 base 的 log-ratio shift 这个假设值得复现，结论强度要等完整消融。
recommendation.en: Read the method: representing capability as a log-ratio shift from the base is the useful idea, but the claim needs full ablations.

paper.title: Performance, Efficiency and Collapse -- Advantages and Challenges in Offline Post-training of Code LLMs
paper.abstract: Post-training with reinforcement learning (RL) is a critical phase in the development of code-generating large language models (LLMs), as it ensures adherence to instructions and the production of functionally correct code. This process typically requires computationally intensive code sample generation from Transformer-based LLMs and substantial GPU-CPU communication for sequence verification. To address these computational challenges, this work examines whether RL-based post-training can be pe

summary.core_problem: 解决代码 LLM 的 RL 后训练是否必须依赖在线采样与在线验证，还是可以用离线数据完成的问题。
summary.importance: 这属于 pretrain↔post-train 接口问题。价值不在代码任务本身，而在于它测试了一个更一般的假设：高成本 RL 后训练能否被离线化，从而降低训练成本并改变对在线 rollout 必要性的 prior。
summary.technical_approach: 作者研究离线 post-training：不再从当前策略在线生成代码样本并执行验证，而是直接利用已有数据集进行 RL 式训练。论文同时讨论收益、效率与 collapse 风险，重点是比较离线训练相对在线 RL 的可行性与稳定性。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出模型规模覆盖 0.5B 到 7B，训练只需数小时，零样本代码生成性能可显著提升；不同模型家族收益不同。摘要未提供具体基线名称、数据集和提升幅度，因此结论目前更像方向性信号，仍需看正文确认 setup 是否干净。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether RL-style post-training for code LLMs truly requires online sampling and verification, or whether it can be done effectively with offline data only.
summary_en.importance: This matters as a pretrain↔post-train interface question. The value is not just code generation, but the broader claim that expensive RL post-training may be partially replaced by offline procedures, potentially changing the prior on the necessity of online rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors study offline post-training: instead of generating fresh code samples from the current policy and verifying them online, they train using existing datasets in an RL-style setup. The paper emphasizes the trade-off among performance, efficiency, and collapse risk.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments from 0.5B to 7B models, with substantial zero-shot code-generation gains after only a few hours of training. Gains vary by model family. Since the abstract lacks concrete baselines, datasets, and effect sizes, the result should be treated as a directional signal until the setup is checked in detail.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 RL 信号能否反哺预训练，这篇值得看设定而不是看分数；先读 collapse 分析和不同 model family 的差异。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the setup, not the headline numbers: focus on collapse behavior and why gains differ across model families if you care about RL signals feeding back into pretraining.

paper.title: Encrypt What Matters: When Selective Homomorphic Inference Is Efficient
paper.abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables inference on private data without revealing it to the server, but evaluating an entire input under FHE is expensive. We study \emph{selective homomorphic inference}, where only a sensitive region of interest (ROI) is encrypted, and computations independent of that region are performed in plaintext. Selective evaluation produces the same output as full FHE on the same model, without retraining. Its efficiency depends on how quickly encrypted dependencies

summary.core_problem: 在不重训模型的前提下，研究“只对输入的敏感 ROI 做同态加密推理”何时能显著加速，以及加速由什么结构性质决定。
summary.importance: 贡献是把 FHE 推理的瓶颈归因到“加密依赖在网络中扩散速度”，并给出对架构局部性(locality)的可操作判据；对 LLM 侧的启发主要在隐私推理/安全部署与架构混合(mixing)的效率权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 selective homomorphic inference：ROI 相关计算在密文域执行，其余在明文域执行，保证输出等价于全 FHE；分析不同网络中加密依赖如何传播，指出早期全局混合会迅速污染全网导致几乎无加速，而保持局部性的结构可获得数量级加速。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型/任务与加速数字细节，仅宣称“小 ROI + locality-preserving 架构可达数量级加速；早期 global mixing 基本无收益”。需要看正文的实验设置是否覆盖卷积/ViT/MLP 等代表结构，以及 ROI 大小-速度曲线是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: When can selective homomorphic inference (encrypt only a sensitive ROI) yield large speedups without retraining, and what architectural property governs the benefit?
summary_en.importance: It attributes FHE efficiency to how fast encrypted dependencies spread through the network, offering an actionable notion of architectural locality; for LLM researchers, the value is mainly in privacy inference/deployment trade-offs and mixing vs locality considerations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Selective evaluation runs ROI-dependent computation under FHE and ROI-independent parts in plaintext while matching full-FHE outputs; the paper analyzes dependency spread and argues early global mixing quickly makes most activations depend on encrypted inputs, eliminating speedups, whereas locality-preserving designs can deliver order-of-magnitude gains.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks concrete model/task details; it claims order-of-magnitude speedups for small ROIs with locality-preserving architectures and near-zero gains with early global mixing. The credibility hinges on the breadth of architectures and robustness of ROI-size vs latency curves.

recommendation.zh: 结论很“工程真相”：早期全局混合=FHE 选择性加密直接失效；只需看依赖扩散分析和速度曲线，别指望对训练侧有新东西。
recommendation.en: A practical takeaway: early global mixing kills selective-FHE gains; skim the dependency-spread analysis and latency curves—don’t expect new pretraining insights.

paper.title: Speculative Probing: LLM Monitoring at Speculative-Decoding Cost
paper.abstract: Real-time classification during language model inference is valuable for safety filtering, behavioral analysis, and model monitoring, but current approaches force a trade-off between accuracy and efficiency. Hidden-state probes are fast but limited: they are either not context-aware: operating on a single vector and cannot model interactions across positions; or they are very costly: having dedicated classifier models (Llama Guard, Qwen Guard, LLM-as-judge) or performing computation on hidden st

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是在线监控 LLM 生成时的成本与精度矛盾。简单 hidden-state probe 很便宜，但通常只看最后一个位置或少量向量，难以建模跨 token 交互；独立安全分类器、LLM-as-judge 或对全序列 hidden states 做较重计算又会显著增加延迟。作者提出把已有 speculative decoding 的 draft head 当作冻结特征提取器，用接近 speculative decoding 的额外成本做序列分类。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座研究的启发主要在两个点。第一，co-pretrained MTP head 不只是推理加速模块，它在大规模预训练期间学到的多步预测表示可以被复用为监控特征；这说明 auxiliary pretraining objective 可能产生可迁移的内部表征。第二，论文给出了 co-pretrained MTP 与 post-hoc distilled Eagle3 的直接经验对比：前者在多数分类任务上高 4–12 个百分点。这个结果支持一个判断：draft head 的训练阶段、数据规模和与 base model 的联合训练方式，会影响它作为 probe feature 的质量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接。冻结 base model 和 speculative-decoding head，在输入后追加 k 个可学习 soft-prompt 向量，再接一个线性分类头。MTP head 接收 base model 最后一层 hidden states 和右移后的 input embeddings，经过归一化、拼接、线性融合，再送入单层 causal decoder；多步预测时递归使用自身前一步 hidden state。Eagle3 形态类似，但输入是低/中/高多层 hidden states 的融合，并且通常是在冻结 base model 上后验蒸馏。Speculative Probing 利用这些 draft head 已经存在的 KV cache，只增加少量 head forward，不改变主推理路径。Qwen3.5-27B 上 k=5 时，每个任务只训练约 18K 参数；全文给出的范围约为 16K–20K 参数。与普通 probe 相比，它不是只读一个 hidden vector，而是让 draft head 在 soft prompt 位置上做一次小型上下文聚合；与外部 classifier 相比，它避免了再跑一个完整模型。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类 speculative head：Qwen3.5-4B/9B/27B 的 co-pretrained MTP，以及 MiniCPM4.1-8B 的 post-hoc Eagle3。任务包括 instruction contradiction、chain-of-thought 中 repetitive thinking 检测、branched thinking 检测、多语言 prompt safety。结果显示，两类 head 上的 probe 都超过 zero-shot GPT-5.4-mini；在多语言安全分类上，结果达到或超过 Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B、Llama-Guard-3-8B 等专用 8B 安全分类器。Qwen MTP probe 在多数任务上比 MiniCPM Eagle3 probe 高 4–12 个百分点。消融包括 soft prompt 长度，以及使用可训练线性分类头还是复用冻结 LM head；这些消融主要用于说明性能来自 draft head 表征与少量可学习提示的配合，而不是来自大规模新增参数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中关于 MTP 与 Eagle3 训练差异的讨论，这是最有信息量的部分；再看 Method 中 MTP/Eagle3 输入输出和 recursive soft prompt 的实现方式。实验部分优先看 §6.5，因为那里比较了 co-pretrained MTP 与 post-hoc Eagle3，对理解“预训练出来的辅助头是否更适合做 feature extractor”最直接。对做 serving 或安全监控的人，可以再看 prompt length 与 classifier head 的消融，判断部署时是否需要为每个监控任务维护独立小头。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the latency–accuracy trade-off in real-time LLM monitoring. Cheap hidden-state probes usually read one or a few vectors and miss interactions across positions. Dedicated guard models, LLM judges, or heavy sequence-level hidden-state pooling improve accuracy but add substantial inference cost. The proposed solution is to reuse the speculative-decoding draft head as a frozen feature extractor for sequence classification.
summary_en.importance: The main pretraining-related signal is that a co-pretrained MTP head is not merely an inference accelerator. Because it is trained jointly with the base model on the pretraining corpus, its representations can support downstream monitoring tasks with very little task-specific training. The comparison with post-hoc distilled Eagle3 is also informative: MTP-based probes are reported to be 4–12 percentage points stronger on most tasks. This suggests that the training stage, data scale, and joint optimization of auxiliary decoding heads matter for their value as reusable model-internal features.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method freezes both the base model and the speculative-decoding head. It appends k learned soft-prompt vectors to the sequence and trains only a linear classifier on top. In the MTP setup, the head consumes the base model’s final hidden states and shifted input embeddings, normalizes and concatenates them, projects the fused representation, and runs a single causal decoder layer. For future-token prediction beyond the first step, MTP recursively feeds its own previous hidden state together with the corresponding token embedding. Eagle3 has a similar one-layer draft-head form, but fuses low, middle, and high hidden states and is distilled after the base model is frozen. Speculative Probing exploits the draft head and its KV cache already present in speculative decoding, so the added cost is a few lightweight head passes rather than a second full classifier model. On Qwen3.5-27B with k=5, the trainable parameter count is about 18K per task; the reported range is roughly 16K–20K.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers co-pretrained MTP heads from Qwen3.5-4B/9B/27B and a post-hoc Eagle3 head from MiniCPM4.1-8B. The four binary classification tasks are instruction contradiction, repetitive thinking detection in chain-of-thought traces, branched thinking detection, and multilingual prompt safety. Probes built on both head families outperform zero-shot GPT-5.4-mini. On multilingual prompt safety, they match or beat dedicated 8B safety classifiers such as Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B and Llama-Guard-3-8B. Qwen MTP probes are reported to outperform MiniCPM Eagle3 probes by 4–12 percentage points on most tasks. Ablations study soft-prompt length and the choice between a trainable linear classifier and reusing the frozen LM head.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the introduction’s discussion of co-pretrained MTP versus post-hoc Eagle3, since it contains the key research signal. Then read the method section for the recursive soft-prompt design and how the draft head is reused without changing the main inference path. In the experiments, prioritize §6.5, which is the most relevant part for understanding whether pretraining-time auxiliary heads produce better monitoring features. The prompt-length and classifier-head ablations are useful for deployment decisions.

recommendation.zh: 将推测解码模块复用为分类器的思路很巧妙，为低成本的实时监控提供了一个新视角，值得关注其具体实现和开销分析。
recommendation.en: The idea of repurposing the speculative decoding module as a classifier is clever, offering a new perspective for low-cost real-time monitoring; worth checking the implementation details and overhead analysis.

paper.title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off
paper.abstract: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring fr

summary.core_problem: 注意力机制十年来衍生大量变体，缺乏在效率（efficiency）、表达力（expressiveness）、可解释性（interpretability）三维度下的系统比较，且细粒度排名是否可靠存疑。
summary.importance: 综述贡献：梳理从 Bahdanau/Luong 到 Transformer 及高效注意力的发展脉络，提出 EEI 三维评分框架比较 21 种方法；核心发现是排名在扰动下高度不稳定，只适合粗粒度分层比较。
summary.technical_approach: 单评分者对 21 种注意力方法按 EEI 三维打分（假设 ±1 分扰动），用 200,000 次确定性 Monte Carlo 分析排名稳定性，并与 rank-matched null model 对照。
summary.experiments: 67-70% 的样本中排名变化超过一位；null model 重现类似稳定性，表明细粒度排名不可靠，应仅做 tier-level 比较。

summary_en.core_problem: A decade of attention variants has produced no systematic comparison along efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and the reliability of fine-grained rankings is questionable.
summary_en.importance: Survey contribution: traces attention from Bahdanau-Luong alignment through Transformers and efficient variants, proposing an EEI scoring framework across 21 methods; the key finding is that rankings are highly unstable under perturbation, supporting only coarse tier-level comparisons.
summary_en.technical_approach: A single rater scores 21 attention methods on EEI dimensions (assuming ±1-point perturbation), with 200,000-sample deterministic Monte Carlo analysis of rank stability, compared against a rank-matched null model.
summary_en.experiments: Rank changes of more than one position occur in 67-70% of samples; the null model reproduces a similar stability profile, indicating fine-grained rankings are unreliable.

recommendation.zh: 单评分者综述，结论（注意力排名不稳定）不算意外；作为注意力变体的文献地图备查即可，不值得通读。
recommendation.en: Single-rater survey whose conclusion (attention rankings are unstable) is unsurprising; keep as a literature map of attention variants but not worth a full read.

paper.title: TASQ: Temporal-Adaptive Bit Sparsification Quantization for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Static quantization assigns one weight precision to every denoising step. To preserve quality, that precision must accommodate the most quantization-sensitive step, even though many other steps can tolerate fewer bits. The resulting model may satisfy its memory budget, but it repeatedly pays worst-case arithmetic throughout the denoising trajectory. We introduce Temporal-Adaptive Bit Sparsification Quantization (TASQ) to separate these two costs. TASQ stores one shared maximum-precision weight b

summary.core_problem: 降低扩散模型采样过程中因静态量化带来的冗余计算，让不同去噪步使用不同有效 bit 数。
summary.importance: 这是扩散模型推理效率工作，贡献在于把存储精度和实际算术精度解耦。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对多模态生成模型部署、bit-serial 执行和时间步敏感性分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: TASQ 保留一个共享的最高精度权重缓冲区，避免为每个时间步存多份权重；同时学习 Temporal-Spatial LSB Mask，在不同层和不同去噪阶段截断最低有效位，形成动态有效精度。Temporal-Precision Engine 将该精度日程映射到 bit-serial 执行，使计算周期随有效 bit 数变化，并声称精度切换没有可测量的 cycle overhead。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 PixArt-Sigma 等扩散模型上实验，目标是在固定存储预算下减少 BitOPs 并保持生成质量；未给出完整模型规模、数据集、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Sungkyunkwan University、University of Arizona、Duke University。Yiran Chen 长期从事高效 AI、硬件与系统方向研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Reduce redundant arithmetic in diffusion-model sampling by allowing different denoising steps to use different effective weight precisions.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper for diffusion models. Its main contribution is separating storage precision from arithmetic precision. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to multimodal-generation serving and bit-serial hardware execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: TASQ keeps a shared maximum-precision weight buffer to avoid per-step weight copies, while learning a Temporal-Spatial LSB Mask that truncates least-significant bits per layer and denoising stage. A Temporal-Precision Engine maps the learned schedule to bit-serial execution, where cycle count scales with effective precision and precision switching is claimed to have no measured cycle overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on PixArt-Sigma and related diffusion settings, targeting lower BitOPs under a fixed storage budget while preserving generation quality. Exact model scales, datasets, baselines, and numerical gains are not available in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Sungkyunkwan University, University of Arizona, and Duke University. Yiran Chen is known for work on efficient AI systems and hardware.

recommendation.zh: 只看动态 bit 日程和硬件映射部分即可；它验证了 diffusion 去噪步敏感性不均匀，但离 LLM 预训练较远。

paper.title: Stop When Memory Suffices: Evidence-Conditioned Progressive Execution for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: The continued development of LLMs toward persistent and adaptive intelligence increasingly requires long-term memory mechanisms that preserve and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems either compress and structure histories for efficient access or perform deep research over broader trajectories. The former lowers online cost but may omit temporal, causal, or cross-step dependencies, while the latter improves evidence coverage at substantial latency and inference cost. Th

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 记忆访问存在固定计算深度的问题：轻量检索可能丢失跨步骤、因果或时间依赖，而对每次查询都执行完整深度记忆推理又会带来不必要的延迟和推理成本。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，更偏向 Agent 记忆系统与推理时计算分配。但其“先共享检索前缀，再由证据充分性决定是否继续计算”的思路，与自适应计算、条件化推理、测试时计算预算分配有相通之处，可作为思考模型何时停止深入推理的工程参考。
summary.technical_approach: Router-Mem 将记忆查询组织为渐进式执行。首先执行一个共享的低成本检索前缀，得到初始证据上下文；随后由轻量 sufficiency router 判断当前证据是否足以回答查询。路由器使用证据级监督和 rationale distillation 训练，推理时输出单 token 决策。若证据充分，直接生成答案并跳过后续计算；若不充分，则复用已有检索命中作为定位信号，扩展相关记忆块并调用更深层的分析与证据聚合。快速路径和慢速路径通过共享前缀耦合，避免重新检索。
summary.experiments: 在 AMA-Bench 和 BEAM 上，Router-Mem 分别取得 55.17% 和 38.77% 的分数，同时相对完整记忆处理流程将平均推理时间降低 27.3% 和 25.5%。不同路由阈值下，方法在质量—延迟权衡上形成较优的 Pareto 前沿，说明提前终止主要节省了证据已局部充分的查询，而没有明显牺牲困难查询的回答质量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。建议重点看引言中两类记忆系统的对比、图 1 的框架设计，以及方法部分对共享检索前缀、sufficiency router 和检索引导续算的描述。实验部分关注质量—延迟曲线和阈值消融。预计阅读时间约 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon agent memory systems use a fixed processing depth: lightweight retrieval may miss temporal, causal, or cross-step dependencies, while running full memory research for every query adds unnecessary latency and inference cost.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly an agent-memory and inference-time compute allocation paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect: the shared retrieval prefix followed by a learned sufficiency gate is a concrete instance of adaptive computation and conditional reasoning, useful when thinking about when a model should stop thinking or retrieve more context.
summary_en.technical_approach: Router-Mem frames memory access as evidence-conditioned progressive execution. Every query first runs a shared low-cost retrieval prefix to obtain initial evidence. A lightweight sufficiency router, trained with evidence-level supervision and rationale distillation, makes a single-token decision about whether that evidence is enough. If sufficient, the system answers immediately and skips the remaining pipeline. If not, it reuses the retrieval hits as localization signals, expands relevant memory blocks, and runs deeper analysis and evidence aggregation. The fast and slow paths share the retrieval prefix, so the slow path does not restart search from scratch.
summary_en.experiments: On AMA-Bench and BEAM, Router-Mem scores 55.17% and 38.77% while reducing average inference time by 27.3% and 25.5% relative to full memory processing. Across routing thresholds, it maintains a favorable quality–latency Pareto frontier, suggesting that early termination saves compute mainly on locally answerable queries without substantially hurting harder cases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the introduction’s contrast between preprocessing-oriented and query-time reconstruction memory systems, Figure 1 for the pipeline, and the method description of the shared prefix, sufficiency router, and retrieval-guided continuation. In experiments, look at the quality–latency curves and threshold ablations. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关注 Agent 长上下文处理效率的必读，其核心 insight 是用轻量级 router 做 early exit，这对于设计 RAG 或长程 Agent 的 serving 架构很有启发。
recommendation.en: A must-read for those focusing on agent long-context efficiency; the core insight of using a lightweight router for early exit is highly inspiring for designing serving architectures for RAG or long-horizon agents.
