paper.title: CHILL-Harness: Counterfactual Harness Learning for Efficient Reasoning in Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Agent harnesses have become the operational infrastructure of modern large language model agents, coordinating context, tools, verification, and execution control to translate latent model capability into reliable long-horizon behavior. However, reliable long-horizon behavior requires harness control to adapt to task demands, execution environments, and evolving execution states, whereas current harnesses predominantly rely on hand-crafted or globally fixed policies; this mismatch manifests as u

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注长程 Agent 的 harness 控制问题：在同一个执行状态下，是否应该触发额外规划、验证、工具调用、回滚或其他编排动作。固定规则会带来冗余推理，也可能在错误时机打断流程。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，更接近 Agent runtime 和后训练后的系统编排。但它有一个可借鉴点：把执行轨迹里的 harness 动作做成因果干预问题，而不是只看相关性。这对构造高质量 Agent 轨迹、做长程任务 credit assignment、筛选 SFT/RL 数据有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分成两层。CIEL 负责估计干预效果，把不同类型的编排行为统一表示，并从带置信度的执行证据中学习“相对当前事实流程的优势”。这里的优势不是简单的成功率差，而是给定当前上下文后，某个候选编排动作相对不干预或其他干预的预期收益。ARCO 负责把估计结果落到执行策略上：先做反事实 deliberation，再生成候选动作，并且只有当估计优势超过 margin 时才允许改写 workflow。论文还加入 success-preserving objective 和 advantage-margin authorization constraints，目的是在效果估计不确定时避免为了省 token 牺牲任务成功。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖信息检索、软件工程和终端交互三类长程任务。给出的结论是：CHILL-Harness 能保持或提升任务成功率，同时减少 token 消耗和执行时间。当前提供的全文片段没有包含具体表格、绝对数值、模型规模、任务规模或消融结果，因此不能确认提升幅度。需要重点核对完整实验部分中 CIEL、ARCO、margin constraint、confidence weighting 的单独贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–25 分钟。优先看问题定义、CIEL 的 intervention-relative advantage 形式化、ARCO 的授权条件，以及实验中的成本—成功率 trade-off。若只关心基座预训练，可以跳过具体 harness 工程细节，重点看执行轨迹如何被转成可学习的干预样本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets adaptive control in long-horizon agent harnesses: given the same execution state, should the system invoke extra planning, verification, tool use, rollback, or other orchestration actions. Fixed harness policies can waste reasoning budget and may interrupt the workflow at the wrong time.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited; the work is mainly about agent runtime orchestration after model training. The useful idea is trace-level causal credit assignment for harness interventions. That can inform how to filter agent trajectories, construct SFT/RL data for long-horizon tasks, and separate useful intervention behavior from actions that merely correlate with success.
summary_en.technical_approach: CHILL-Harness has two main components. CIEL estimates context-conditioned intervention effects by mapping heterogeneous orchestration behaviors into a unified effect-learning problem and learning intervention-relative advantages from confidence-weighted execution evidence. ARCO then realizes those estimates at runtime: it performs counterfactual deliberation before candidate generation and authorizes workflow changes only when the estimated causal-operational advantage clears a margin. A success-preserving objective and advantage-margin constraints are used to reduce unsafe adaptation under uncertain effect estimates.
summary_en.experiments: The reported evaluation spans information-seeking, software-engineering, and terminal-interaction tasks. The stated outcome is that CHILL-Harness preserves or improves task success while reducing token usage and wall-clock execution time. The provided full-content excerpt does not include numeric results, model sizes, task counts, or ablation tables, so the actual magnitude of improvement cannot be verified from the supplied material.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–25 minutes. Focus on the formalization of causal harness orchestration, the definition of intervention-relative advantage in CIEL, the authorization rule in ARCO, and the success-versus-cost plots or tables if available. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most transferable part is how execution traces are converted into learnable intervention evidence.

recommendation.zh: 将 Agent harness 的调度视为因果学习问题，思路新颖，对设计更高效的 Agent 系统有一定参考价值，可关注其干预机制设计。
recommendation.en: Formulating agent harness orchestration as a causal learning problem is a novel idea, providing reference value for designing more efficient agent systems; the intervention mechanism design is worth noting.

paper.title: WaveZip: Wavelet-Driven Space-Time Decoupling for Video Token Condensation
paper.abstract: Existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) struggle with long-form video understanding due to the quadratic computational cost of visual tokens. While recent efficient methods attempt to compress tokens via hard pruning or uniform merging, they operate strictly in the spatial feature domain, where robust structural context and discriminative semantic details are inherently entangled. In this work, we propose WaveZip, a joint signal-frequency-domain framework for efficient video inference. Dri

summary.core_problem: 长视频输入LVLM时会产生海量时空视觉token，导致注意力计算复杂度随token数二次增长，推理效率低下。现有token压缩方法直接在空间特征域操作：硬剪枝会破坏空间连贯性，均匀合并会模糊语义显著区域，根源是这类方法在空域无法解耦两类混淆——空间维度上，任务相关的细粒度证据和冗余背景纹理混杂；时间维度上，慢变的语义趋势和采样噪声、视觉抖动、场景突变等高频波动混杂，即频率混淆问题。
summary.importance: 这个工作从频域视角给出了无需训练、即插即用的视频token压缩方案，其按频带分配token预算的思路，对多模态统一预训练中的视觉token冗余处理、视觉tokenizer设计、长视频建模效率优化有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: WaveZip选择离散小波变换（DWT）做时空分解，因为DWT具备局部性、可逆性、多子带分解的特性。时间维度：对帧级查询相关性序列做1D DWT，用帧间视觉变化先验门控高频细节系数，经逆DWT重构校正后的相关性序列，指导自适应的帧级token预算分配。空间维度：对每帧特征图做2D DWT，保留代表结构的低频近似子带，用查询条件的空间显著性对高频细节子带重新加权，重构后的特征按分配的预算下采样，投影为紧凑视觉token。整个流程不需要任务特定训练，可直接集成到现有LVLM中。
summary.experiments: 现有手稿的实验部分内容截断，已公开部分提到在多个长视频理解基准、多款LVLM骨干上开展测试，相比硬剪枝、均匀合并等空域压缩基线，相同压缩率下能保留更多任务相关语义细节，性能损失更小，且无额外训练开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点看引言部分对现有压缩方法缺陷的频率视角分析，以及方法部分的时空DWT分解逻辑，理解为什么频域解耦能避免空域压缩“要么丢信息要么模糊”的问题。不用深究具体小波基选择的工程细节，核心收获是按信息频率差异化分配token预算的思路。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long video inputs to LVLMs produce thousands of spatiotemporal visual tokens, leading to quadratic attention complexity and poor inference efficiency. Existing token compression methods operate directly in the spatial feature domain: hard pruning breaks spatial coherence, while uniform merging blurs semantically salient regions. The root issue is frequency conflation: in the spatial dimension, task-relevant fine-grained evidence is mixed with redundant background texture; in the temporal dimension, slow-varying semantic trends are mixed with high-frequency fluctuations from sampling noise, visual jitter, and abrupt scene changes.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a training-free, plug-and-play video token compression framework built on frequency-domain decomposition. Its core design—allocating token budgets based on separated frequency bands—offers useful reference for handling visual token redundancy in unified multimodal pretraining, designing efficient visual tokenizers, and optimizing long-video modeling efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: WaveZip uses the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) for spatiotemporal decomposition, chosen for its localized support, invertibility, and multi-band decomposition properties. Temporally, it applies 1D DWT to frame-level query relevance sequences, gates high-frequency detail coefficients with an inter-frame visual change prior, and reconstructs a rectified relevance sequence via inverse DWT to guide adaptive frame-level token budget allocation. Spatially, it applies 2D DWT to per-frame feature maps, retains the low-frequency approximation subband that encodes structural information, and reweights high-frequency detail subbands with query-conditioned spatial saliency. Reconstructed features are downsampled according to allocated budgets and projected to compact visual tokens. The entire pipeline requires no task-specific training and integrates directly with off-the-shelf LVLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental section of the available manuscript is truncated. Publicly described results report tests across multiple long-video understanding benchmarks and LVLM backbones, showing that WaveZip retains more task-relevant semantic details and suffers less performance degradation than spatial-domain baselines (hard pruning, uniform merging) at equivalent compression ratios, with no additional training overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the frequency-domain critique of existing compression methods in the introduction, and the spatiotemporal DWT decomposition logic in the method section, to understand how frequency disentanglement avoids the common tradeoff between information loss and blurring in spatial-domain compression. Engineering details of specific wavelet kernel selection can be skipped. The core transferable idea is allocating token budgets differentially based on information frequency bands. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“压缩决策放到频域”这条路走得更系统，适合做长视频推理的可解释基线；重点看频带假设是否在不同数据集/模型上稳。
recommendation.en: A more principled frequency-domain take on token compression; skim for whether the wavelet-band assumptions hold across models/datasets before adopting it as a serving baseline.

paper.title: Efficient Text-to-Audio Generation via Pruning
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based text-to-audio generative models such as AudioLDM achieve high perceptual quality and strong semantic consistency; however, their practical deployment is hindered by the substantial computational cost of the U-Net denoising backbone. In this work, we apply model pruning to improve the computational efficiency of AudioLDM, a U-Net-based text-conditioned audio latent diffusion model. We analyse parameter redundancy across U-Net convolutional blocks and evaluate a filter-pruning stra

summary.core_problem: 降低扩散式文本到音频生成（AudioLDM）中U-Net去噪骨干的推理/训练计算成本，便于部署。
summary.importance: 属于生成模型效率工程：用结构化剪枝换取MAC/参数下降，并观察到对特定声事件的能力退化；对“多模态生成系统如何做压缩与风险评估”有参考，但不触及LLM基座预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach: 分析U-Net卷积块冗余，采用基于权重范数的filter pruning；剪枝后做轻量finetune以恢复质量，并对剪枝影响的声事件类型做定性/定量分析。
summary.experiments: 以AudioLDM为基线；报告最高约83%参数、39% MAC降低，同时生成质量保持或部分提升；指出剪枝会影响某些事件（含安全关键如枪声/警报等）的生成能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Reducing the compute cost of U-Net denoisers in diffusion-based text-to-audio generation (AudioLDM) for practical deployment.
summary_en.importance: Efficiency-focused pruning work; useful as a reference for compressing multimodal generative backbones and auditing capability regressions, but not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Norm-based filter pruning on U-Net conv blocks after redundancy analysis, followed by lightweight finetuning; includes analysis of which sound events degrade after pruning.
summary_en.experiments: AudioLDM baseline; up to ~83% parameter and ~39% MAC reduction with maintained or sometimes improved quality; reports event-specific failures (including safety-critical sounds).

recommendation.zh: 只看剪枝比例与“能力掉点”分析即可：它提醒压缩会引入长尾/安全关键能力塌陷，但方法本身是常规范数剪枝。
recommendation.en: Skim the pruning ratios and the capability-regression analysis: it’s a reminder that compression can break long-tail/safety-critical events, but the method is standard norm pruning.

paper.title: When Is a Draft Accepted? A Theory of Acceptance in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language model inference by using a fast drafter to propose candidate tokens that are then verified by a larger target model. Existing theory largely studies the stochastic, distribution-preserving setting, where the goal is to exactly sample from the target distribution. In contrast, many practical systems use greedy decoding, relaxed acceptance rules, or tree-based candidate sets, where success is governed by local ranking and threshold events rather than exact

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究实际 speculative decoding 中“draft token 什么时候会被接受”的判定问题，重点不在保持精确采样分布，而在 greedy、relaxed greedy 和 tree-based decoding 这些工程常用设置下，如何用 target/draft 分布差异给出可证明的接受条件。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对大模型推理系统和小 draft 模型训练有直接参考价值。它把 accepted length 从经验指标转成局部概率几何问题：draft 与 target 的 KL 小到什么程度时，可以保证 draft 不会被拒绝。这有助于判断 drafter 蒸馏、共享层 drafter、Medusa-style 多头预测等方法的优化目标是否真的对接受率有帮助。尤其值得注意的是，它分析的是很多线上系统使用的非分布保持规则，而不是经典 speculative sampling 的无偏采样设置。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的核心是把一类接受规则统一写成 target distribution 的 lower level set。直观地说，拒绝区域由 target 模型认为概率较低的一组 token 构成；只要 draft 分布与 target 分布的 KL 距离低于某个证书阈值，draft 选出的 token 就不可能落入拒绝区域，从而保证接受。工作给出了单 token draft 的统一 KL certificate，并把 strict greedy acceptance、additive relaxation、multiplicative relaxation、top-m relaxed acceptance、entropy-based acceptance 作为推论处理。它还扩展到简单的 greedy tree decoding，分析分支数 m 与局部接受之间的关系，并给出 tree certificate 的通用上界 log(m+1)，对应单 token 情况下的 log(2) ceiling。与已有理论主要研究 stochastic、distribution-preserving speculative sampling 不同，这里关注 deterministic/local ranking 事件，即 argmax、阈值和候选集合覆盖。
summary.experiments: 实证部分使用 Qwen3 系列模型的输出分布统计来检验这些 KL certificate 的形态。核心现象是 relaxed acceptance 和 tree-based criteria 会扩大 certified acceptance 区域，低置信步骤上尤其明显，因为 strict greedy 在 target top-1 不稳定时容易拒绝，而放宽阈值或提供多个候选可以覆盖更多局部不确定性。给出的正文没有展示端到端 latency、throughput 或 accepted length 的具体数字，也没有看到不同 drafter 参数量和训练方式的系统比较；实验更像是验证理论边界与模型输出分布的匹配关系。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看三个部分：第一，single draft token 的统一 certificate，理解 lower level set 如何把不同接受规则归到同一类；第二，tight lower/upper bound 的构造，确认这些 KL 阈值不是松散不等式；第三，tree-based greedy decoding 的 log(m+1) 上界，它解释了为什么树状候选能在低置信位置提高接受机会。做 serving 或 drafter 训练的人可以进一步关注 relaxed acceptance 的几类规则，因为这些规则更接近实际系统。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when a draft token is accepted in practical speculative decoding, focusing on greedy, relaxed greedy, and tree-based regimes rather than exact distribution-preserving sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining paper, but it gives useful signal for training and evaluating draft models. It connects acceptance length to local distributional geometry: how close the drafter must be to the target, in KL divergence, before rejection becomes impossible under a given acceptance rule. That is relevant when deciding whether to train a standalone drafter, a shared-layer drafter, or Medusa-style prediction heads, because lower loss is only useful insofar as it improves the local rank and threshold events used by the verifier.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main idea is to characterize many acceptance rules as rejection regions that are lower level sets of the target distribution. If the draft distribution is sufficiently close to the target distribution, measured by a KL certificate, then the draft’s chosen token cannot fall into the rejection set and acceptance is guaranteed. The framework covers strict greedy acceptance, additive and multiplicative relaxations, top-m relaxed acceptance, and entropy-based acceptance as special cases. The paper also extends the analysis to a simple greedy tree-decoding setting, relates the branching factor m to local acceptance, and derives a universal log(m+1) upper bound on the tree certificate, generalizing the log(2) ceiling in the single-token case. The distinction from earlier theory is important: the analysis targets deterministic ranking and threshold events, not unbiased stochastic speculative sampling.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section computes output-distribution statistics on Qwen3 models and compares them with the derived certificates. The reported qualitative finding is that relaxed and tree-based acceptance rules enlarge the certified acceptance region, especially at low-confidence decoding steps where strict greedy matching is brittle. The available text does not provide end-to-end latency numbers, throughput gains, accepted-token counts, or a detailed comparison across drafter sizes and training recipes; the experiments are primarily distributional diagnostics for the theory.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the unified single-token certificate first, since that is where the lower-level-set view becomes clear. Then check the tightness arguments for the lower and upper bounds, because they determine whether the KL thresholds are operationally meaningful. Finally, read the tree-decoding section and the Qwen3 distributional analysis. Practitioners working on serving or drafter distillation should pay special attention to the relaxed acceptance rules, which are closer to deployed systems than exact speculative sampling.

recommendation.zh: 推测解码工业落地变体的首个统一理论，做推理部署的重点读 §3 边际界推导，预训练选draft模型可参考其KL散度结论。
recommendation.en: First unified theory for industrial speculative decoding variants; inference teams focus on §3 margin bound derivations, pretrain teams can reference its KL divergence conclusions for draft model selection.

paper.title: CascadeFormer: Depth-Tapered Transformers Motivated by Gradient Fan-in Asymmetry
paper.abstract: Deep Transformers are composed of uniformly stacked residual blocks, yet their deepest layers often add little value. We present two efficiency methods that exploit this asymmetry. CascadeFormer tapers width with depth to match the uneven information flow across layers, achieving comparable perplexity to a uniform baseline at the same training budget while reducing latency by 8.6% and increasing throughput by 9.4%. CascadeFlow Pruning removes layers using accumulated training gradients, with no

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解释并利用一个在深层 Transformer 里反复出现、但常被粗略归因为“深层梯度变小”的现象：越靠后的层，功能贡献往往越弱，表示也更冗余。作者给出的更精确问题定义是，问题不只是梯度幅值衰减，而是残差结构导致的梯度组合来源不对称。浅层能汇聚更多下游路径传回来的梯度信号，深层只能接收更少、更简单的组合信号。作者把这种结构性差异称为 Gradient Fan-in Asymmetry，简称 GFA。论文的核心任务有两部分：一是证明这种“梯度扇入不对称”比单纯的梯度大小更能解释深层层冗余；二是把这个解释落到两个可操作方向上，一个是训练时就内生化这种不对称的深度渐缩架构 CascadeFormer，另一个是仅依赖训练过程中累计梯度来做层裁剪的 CascadeFlow Pruning。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它试图把“深层层没那么有用”从经验观察推进到结构解释。过去常见说法是深层梯度弱、训练不到位，但这篇文章强调，优化器即便把梯度放大，也补不回缺失的组合多样性，这个判断会直接影响我们如何理解深层冗余、LayerSkip 一类深监督设计、以及深度扩展的收益边界。第二，它给出了一种和 scaling/架构设计直接相关的思路：如果不同深度天然接收到的信息密度不同，那么统一宽度堆叠未必是最合适的参数分配方式，深度越深越窄反而可能更贴近训练信号分布。第三，它提出的 pruning 信号来自训练期累计梯度，而不是训练后再做昂贵分析，这对大模型训练中的在线结构决策、mid-train 裁剪、甚至动态深度设计都有启发。贡献量级上，这不是改写主流 recipe 的工作，但它提供了一个值得认真对待的结构性解释框架，并给出两个能落地的原型方法。
summary.technical_approach: 技术主线分三步。第一步是提出 GFA 的结构定义。对 Pre-LN 残差堆叠，作者把每层输入梯度展开为来自 identity path 和所有后续 functional path 的累积和。关键不在于完整组合路径数 2^(N-l)，而在于一个更可操作的 proxy：某层能聚合多少个不同下游信号通道，也就是 fan-in。这个 fan-in 随深度线性下降；如果再加中间层辅助监督，浅层会收到更多层级的反传信号，差异会进一步放大到近似二次级别。第二步是做相关性和干预验证。作者先测每层平均梯度范数与最终功能重要性 ΔMi 的正相关，再做两个更关键的 intervention。一个是“幅值补偿”实验：人为放大后层梯度，使其梯度大小更接近前层，但并不能恢复这些层的功能重要性。另一个是“结构补偿”实验：通过 layer repetition 增加后层可接收的路径数，结果能明显恢复其重要性。这个对照是全文最关键的论据，因为它把“梯度大小只是症状”这个说法变成了可检验命题。第三步是方法落地。CascadeFormer 不是简单减层，而是在固定训练 FLOPs 约束下做 depth-tapered width schedule：前层更宽，后层逐步变窄，让容量分配与梯度组合多样性更匹配。它保留标准 Transformer block 形式，只改每层宽度配置，因此兼容现有训练流程。CascadeFlow Pruning 则在训练过程中累计每层梯度统计，把它作为结构重要性的 proxy，直接决定裁掉哪些层。它强调不需要训练后再跑额外敏感性分析，也不依赖激活重放或复杂搜索。和常见按层位置、按权重范数、按单次梯度或按表示相似度裁剪相比，它利用的是训练全过程积累下来的“被多少有用信号持续驱动过”的信息。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖从头训练、最大到 1.2B 参数规模的模型。论文先给出现象层证据：在预训练后的 LLaMA 上，后层表示相似度更高；在 LayerSkip 这类可早退架构上，越后层的边际功能贡献下降更明显。真正的方法实验主要在自训模型上完成。对 CascadeFormer，作者在与 uniform baseline 保持相同训练预算的条件下比较困惑度和推理效率，结论是困惑度基本可比，同时延迟下降 8.6%，吞吐提升 9.4%。这说明 tapering 不是单纯拿质量换速度，而是在相同 train FLOPs 下改善了部署侧形状。对 CascadeFlow Pruning，作者用累计训练梯度做层重要性排序，和标准启发式相比，在 perplexity 与 rank-stability 上更好，下游精度也保持竞争力。摘要没有给出全部具体数字，但从正文叙述看，作者特别强调两点：一是 pruning 排名在不同 checkpoint 或不同评估切片上更稳定，说明信号不是偶然噪声；二是单纯看深度位置或后验表示冗余并不如训练期累计梯度可靠。消融层面，最重要的是两类干预：放大后层梯度幅值无效，而增加后层路径数有效；这组结果支撑了“结构瓶颈而非幅值瓶颈”的中心论点。另一个值得注意的观察是，深监督并没有缓解不对称，反而会把浅层的 fan-in 优势进一步放大，这对 LayerSkip 一类设计是个不太直观但很重要的提醒。
summary.reading_guide: 建议按“假说—干预—方法”顺序读。先看 Introduction 和 GFA 定义部分，重点抓住作者到底在数什么：不是所有组合路径，而是梯度聚合的有效信号通道数。这里如果没读清，后面很容易把文章误解成普通的梯度衰减讨论。然后精读两组 intervention 实验，这是全文最有信息量的部分。要重点看：作者如何人为 equalize late-layer gradient norms；为什么这种做法没有恢复层重要性；layer repetition 又是怎样增加结构 fan-in 的。接着看 CascadeFormer 的宽度调度设计，关注它如何在固定训练 FLOPs 下做参数重分配，以及这种 schedule 是否只是手工启发式，还是由 GFA 统计直接驱动。再看 CFP 的实现细节，尤其是累计梯度的定义窗口、归一化方式、排序稳定性，以及与哪些 pruning baseline 对比。图表上，表示相似度随深度变化、LayerSkip 的层贡献曲线、干预实验图、以及 pruning rank-stability 相关图都值得细看。阅读时还要保留两个开放问题：第一，作者的 fan-in proxy 只数通道，不度量通道间正交性或信息质量，这个 proxy 到底在多大程度上贴近真实“梯度多样性”；第二，结论目前只到 1.2B，自回归大模型在 100B+ 规模、MoE、以及更复杂监督信号下是否仍成立，还没有被验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a recurring phenomenon in deep Transformers: later layers often contribute less and become increasingly redundant, but the usual explanation—smaller gradients in deep layers—is incomplete. The authors argue that the real bottleneck is structural. In Pre-LN residual stacks, shallow layers aggregate gradients from many downstream paths, while deep layers receive gradients from far fewer paths. This creates an asymmetry in the compositional diversity of gradient signals, which they call Gradient Fan-in Asymmetry (GFA). The paper has two goals: first, to show that this structural asymmetry explains late-layer redundancy better than gradient magnitude alone; second, to turn that account into two practical methods, CascadeFormer for depth-tapered architecture design and CascadeFlow Pruning for gradient-based layer pruning during training.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the main value is conceptual and architectural. The paper reframes late-layer under-utilization as a property of residual signal routing rather than a generic optimization failure. That matters because it changes what kinds of interventions are plausible: if the issue is missing gradient diversity, rescaling gradients is not enough. This has implications for how to think about depth scaling, deep supervision, early-exit designs such as LayerSkip, and parameter allocation across depth. The second contribution is more practical: it suggests that uniform-width stacking may be a poor match to how training signal is distributed, and that tapering width with depth can improve deployment efficiency at fixed training FLOPs. The pruning result is also relevant because it uses accumulated training gradients as an online structural importance signal, avoiding expensive post-hoc analysis. This is not a recipe-changing result on the scale of a new optimizer or tokenizer, but it is a serious attempt to connect training dynamics, architecture shape, and pruning through one structural hypothesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The technical story has three parts. First, the paper defines GFA in Pre-LN residual Transformers. Writing the network as x_{l+1} = x_l + F_l(x_l), the input gradient at layer l can be expanded as a sum over identity and downstream functional paths. The key quantity is not the full combinatorial path count, but a tractable proxy: how many distinct downstream signal channels are aggregated into a layer’s gradient. This fan-in decreases with depth. With deep supervision, the imbalance becomes even stronger because shallow layers receive additional gradient hierarchies from auxiliary heads. Second, the paper tests the hypothesis with both correlational and interventional evidence. It first shows that average per-layer gradient norm correlates with eventual functional importance, but then argues norm is only a proxy. In the ablative intervention, the authors artificially amplify late-layer gradient magnitudes; this does not restore late-layer importance. In the constructive intervention, they increase structural path counts through layer repetition; this does restore importance. That contrast is the central argument of the paper. Third, they derive two methods from the GFA account. CascadeFormer uses a depth-tapered width schedule: earlier layers are wider, later layers narrower, under a fixed training-FLOP budget. The idea is to allocate capacity where gradient composition is richer. CascadeFlow Pruning accumulates training gradients over time and uses them as a proxy for structural importance to rank and remove layers. Unlike post-hoc pruning methods based on activation similarity, one-shot sensitivity tests, or simple depth heuristics, CFP uses information gathered throughout training and does not require an extra analysis phase after pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include models trained from scratch up to 1.2B parameters. The paper first presents observational evidence: in pretrained LLaMA, deeper layers show higher representational similarity, and in LayerSkip-style architectures the marginal utility of later layers drops sharply. The main method results are on the authors’ own training runs. For CascadeFormer, under matched training budget, the model reaches perplexity comparable to a uniform-width baseline while reducing inference latency by 8.6% and increasing throughput by 9.4%. That is the clearest practical result: better deployment shape without paying extra training cost. For CascadeFlow Pruning, accumulated training gradients outperform standard pruning heuristics on perplexity and rank stability, while remaining competitive on downstream accuracy. The abstract does not expose all numbers, but the full text emphasizes that the ranking induced by accumulated gradients is more stable across checkpoints and evaluation settings than simpler heuristics. The most important ablations are the two interventions supporting the structural claim: equalizing late-layer gradient magnitude does not recover importance, whereas increasing path multiplicity does. Another notable result is that deep supervision amplifies the asymmetry rather than fixing it, which is a useful caution for architectures that add intermediate losses.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the hypothesis, not the methods. Read the introduction and the GFA section carefully to understand what the fan-in proxy is actually counting. The paper is easy to misread as a standard gradient-attenuation story, but the authors are making a narrower claim about compositional diversity of gradient signals. Then focus on the intervention experiments. Those are the most important parts to verify whether the structural argument holds: how exactly late-layer gradients are amplified, why that fails, and how layer repetition changes the path structure. After that, read the CascadeFormer design section with an eye on the width schedule under fixed training FLOPs. Check whether the tapering rule is directly informed by the GFA account or mostly heuristic. Then read the CFP section, especially how gradients are accumulated, normalized, and converted into a pruning ranking, and how that ranking compares with baselines in terms of stability. The most useful figures are the depth-wise representation similarity plots, the LayerSkip contribution curves, the intervention results, and the pruning rank-stability comparisons. Two open questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: the fan-in proxy counts channels but does not measure their independence or information quality, and all evidence is still in the sub-1.2B regime, so it remains unclear how well the story transfers to 100B-scale dense models, MoE, or more complex supervision setups.

recommendation.zh: 从梯度流角度解释了Transformer深层冗余的机制（GFA），并给出了优雅的架构改进（宽度递减）和剪枝策略，对架构设计和训练动态分析极具启发。
recommendation.en: Explains the mechanism of deep layer redundancy in Transformers from a gradient flow perspective (GFA) and provides elegant architectural improvements (tapered width) and pruning strategies; highly inspiring for architecture design and training dynamics analysis.

paper.title: TOPS: First-Principles Visual Token Pruning via Constructing Token Optimal Preservation Sets for Efficient MLLM Inference
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, but their efficiency is limited by the large number of visual tokens, which introduces substantial computational overhead. Visual token pruning offers a natural solution, yet existing methods are imperfect: attention-based criteria tend to retain redundant tokens, while diversity-based criteria are often agnostic to user instructions. Even methods that combine multiple criteria still lack a principle

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 MLLM 推理中的视觉 token 裁剪问题：如何在大幅减少视觉 token 的同时，尽量保持模型基于完整图像输入时的输出行为。作者认为现有方法多把裁剪做成打分排序问题，常见的 attention-based 方法容易保留相似 token，diversity-based 方法又容易忽略用户问题，缺少一个能解释“为什么这些 token 应该被保留”的目标函数。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，更接近高效推理与多模态 serving。但它对 MLLM 的视觉 token 表示有一定启发：视觉 token 裁剪不能只看局部显著性，也不能只看特征多样性，而要同时考虑 query 条件下的任务相关性、对原始视觉集合的信息覆盖，以及被选 token 之间的冗余控制。这个视角对多模态预训练中的 token budget、视觉 tokenizer 压缩、native multimodal 模型的上下文分配都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: TOPS 把视觉 token 裁剪形式化为构造 Token Optimal Preservation Sets。给定完整视觉 token 集合 V 和文本查询 Q，目标是在固定预算 K 下选择子集 S，使基于 S 和 Q 的输出尽量接近基于 V 和 Q 的输出。作者用互信息目标来展开这个问题：一个好的子集应同时保留关于视觉集合 V 和查询 Q 的信息。由此得到三个准则：Task Relevance，衡量所选 token 与用户问题的相关性；Information Coverage，要求所选 token 能覆盖原始视觉 token 集合中的关键信息；Semantic Diversity，用来避免选择一批语义重复的 token。实现上，TOPS 是训练无关、模型无关的模块，可以插入 MLLM 推理过程中的裁剪点。方法采用两阶段流程：第一阶段先做较粗粒度的视觉冗余去除，第二阶段再进行文本感知的精细筛选，以减少纯视觉多样性方法丢掉任务证据的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 MLLM 和多种视觉问答、图文理解基准。文中明确给出的结果是，在 LLaVA-v1.5-7B 和 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上，TOPS 可以移除接近 90% 的视觉 token，同时分别保留原模型 97.1% 和 99.1% 的性能。作者还比较了不同 reduction ratio 下的方法表现，结论是 TOPS 在激进裁剪时比单纯 attention 或 diversity 策略更稳。关键实验价值在于说明：当 token budget 很低时，只依赖 attention 会保留冗余区域，只依赖 diversity 又可能丢掉 query 所需区域；三类准则结合后，对高压缩率更友好。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Motivation 中从输出散度到互信息目标的推导，以及三条准则如何对应已有方法的缺陷。实验部分重点看不同裁剪率下的性能曲线、LLaVA-v1.5-7B 和 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 的 token 保留比例结果，以及与 attention-based、diversity-based 方法的消融对比。若关注多模态预训练，可重点思考这些准则能否前移到训练阶段，例如用于动态视觉 token 采样、tokenizer 训练或多模态 curriculum。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies visual token pruning for MLLM inference: how to remove a large fraction of image tokens while preserving the model behavior obtained with the full visual input. The authors argue that many existing methods reduce the problem to heuristic scoring. Attention-based criteria often keep redundant tokens, while diversity-based criteria may ignore the user instruction and discard task-critical evidence.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to efficient MLLM inference than to foundation-model pretraining. Its useful signal for pretraining research is the framing of visual tokens as a conditional information budget. A pruning policy should not optimize saliency or diversity alone. It should jointly preserve query-relevant evidence, cover the original visual representation, and avoid semantic redundancy. This is relevant for visual tokenizer design, native multimodal context allocation, and training-time token budgeting.
summary_en.technical_approach: TOPS formulates pruning as the construction of Token Optimal Preservation Sets. Given visual tokens V and a text query Q, the goal is to select a subset S of size K such that the MLLM output with S remains close to the output with the full V. The paper analyzes this objective with mutual information and derives three principles: task relevance, information coverage, and semantic diversity. Task relevance keeps tokens informative for the query. Information coverage keeps the selected subset representative of the original visual token set under the query. Semantic diversity reduces redundancy among selected tokens. The implementation is training-free and model-agnostic. It uses a two-stage pipeline: a first stage removes coarse visual redundancy, and a second stage performs text-aware refinement.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover several MLLMs and multimodal benchmarks. The reported headline numbers are that TOPS removes nearly 90% of visual tokens while retaining 97.1% of the original performance on LLaVA-v1.5-7B and 99.1% on LLaVA-NeXT-7B. The comparisons across reduction ratios suggest that the method is more robust under aggressive pruning than attention-only or diversity-only baselines. The main empirical lesson is that low-budget pruning needs both instruction awareness and coverage control; either criterion alone fails in predictable ways.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Motivation section, especially the transition from output divergence to the mutual-information view and the derivation of the three pruning principles. In the experiments, look for the performance-versus-token-ratio curves, the LLaVA-v1.5-7B and LLaVA-NeXT-7B results, and the ablations separating relevance, coverage, and diversity. For multimodal pretraining work, the useful question is whether these criteria can be moved from inference-time pruning into training-time visual token sampling or tokenizer learning.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 token 预算会长期卡住 native MLLM；只看方法形式化和精度-剪枝曲线，别被“first-principles”措辞带跑。
recommendation.en: Visual-token budgets will keep limiting native MLLMs; skim the formulation and accuracy-pruning curves, and discount the “first-principles” framing.

paper.title: CLP: Collocation-Length Prediction for Zero-Loss Adaptive Multi-Token Inference
paper.abstract: Large language model inference is bottlenecked by autoregressive decoding, where each token requires a full forward pass. Multi-token prediction (MTP) offers a promising acceleration path, but existing approaches suffer from a fundamental architectural flaw: the MTP head for the first token competes with the backbone's own language model (LM) head, leading to severe quality degradation when predictions are accepted. We identify this head-backbone competition as the root cause of repetitive and i

summary.core_problem: 现有多token预测（MTP）推理加速方法存在根本架构缺陷：负责预测第一个后续token的MTP头与主干原生LM头预测同一位置，用精度更低的MTP头输出替换主干输出会导致生成质量严重下降；同时现有门控式接受决策机制存在信息不对称、过于保守、分布失配的固有局限，无法在保质量的前提下实现有效加速。
summary.importance: 定位了过往多token预测加速方法质量下降的根因，给出了零质量损失自适应多token推理的清晰架构原则，对推理部署及多token预测相关的后训练设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Backbone-as-Architect设计原则：主干LM头永远生成每个解码步的第一个token，MTP头仅负责预测t+2及之后的后续token，从架构上彻底消除头与主干的竞争，建立零质量损失基线。提出搭配长度预测器（CLP）：一个仅含4.6K-7.7K参数的单层线性层，基于主干隐藏状态预测可安全接受的后续MTP token数量，替代过往工作中过度设计的门控网络。另外对自适应MTP的质量-速度权衡做了系统的帕累托前沿分析，指出MTP头的预测精度是加速的核心约束。
summary.experiments: 核心实验结果包括：1）k=2的固定步长MTP方法输出重复率超过0.57，而标准贪心解码的重复率仅为0.019，验证了用MTP头输出替换主干输出带来的质量损失。2）现有的门控接受机制过于保守，平均接受长度仅0.4-0.6，几乎无法带来加速效果。3）Backbone-as-Architect设计消除了输出替换带来的质量下降，轻量CLP实现了自适应token接受，在无生成质量损失的前提下获得加速。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读引言部分理解现有MTP方法缺陷的诊断过程，再了解Backbone-as-Architect设计原则与CLP的实现细节，重点查看质量-速度权衡的帕累托前沿分析、与过往MTP方法的对比实验。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-token prediction (MTP) inference acceleration methods suffer from a fundamental architectural flaw: the MTP head predicting the first next token competes with the backbone's native LM head for the same position, and replacing the more accurate backbone output with the lower-accuracy MTP head output causes severe generation quality degradation. Additionally, existing gate-based acceptance mechanisms have intrinsic limitations including information asymmetry, over-conservatism, and distribution mismatch, failing to deliver meaningful acceleration while preserving quality.
summary_en.importance: Identifies and resolves the root cause of quality degradation in prior MTP methods, provides a clean architectural principle for zero-quality-loss adaptive multi-token inference, and offers guidance for inference deployment and MTP-related post-training design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Backbone-as-Architect design principle is proposed: the backbone LM head always generates the first token at each decoding step, and MTP heads are only responsible for predicting tokens from position t+2 onward, eliminating head-backbone competition entirely and establishing a zero-quality-loss baseline. The Collocation-Length Predictor (CLP) is introduced: a single linear layer with only 4.6K-7.7K parameters that operates on the backbone's hidden state to predict the number of subsequent MTP tokens that can be safely accepted, replacing over-engineered gate networks in prior work. A systematic Pareto frontier analysis of the quality-speed tradeoff in adaptive MTP is also provided, identifying MTP head prediction accuracy as the binding constraint for acceleration.
summary_en.experiments: Key results: 1) Fixed-step MTP with k=2 produces outputs with a repetition ratio over 0.57, compared to 0.019 for standard greedy decoding, verifying the quality loss caused by replacing backbone outputs with MTP head predictions. 2) Existing gate-based acceptance mechanisms are over-conservative, achieving an average accepted length of only 0.4-0.6, delivering nearly no acceleration. 3) The Backbone-as-Architect design eliminates quality degradation from output substitution, and the lightweight CLP enables adaptive token acceptance, delivering acceleration without generation quality loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to understand the diagnosis of flaws in existing MTP methods, then review the Backbone-as-Architect principle and CLP implementation details, focus on the Pareto frontier analysis of quality-speed tradeoffs and comparison experiments with prior MTP approaches. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 明确了多token预测质量下降的核心根因，设计极简可落地，建议在内部推理加速方案中复用CLP的span级决策逻辑。
recommendation.en: Identifies the core root cause of quality degradation in multi-token prediction, with a minimal, production-ready design; reuse CLP's span-level decision logic for internal inference acceleration solutions.

paper.title: PortBERT: Navigating the Depths of Portuguese Language Models
paper.abstract: Transformer models dominate modern NLP, but efficient, language-specific models remain scarce. In Portuguese, most focus on scale or accuracy, often neglecting training and deployment efficiency. In the present work, we introduce PortBERT, a family of RoBERTa-based language models for Portuguese, designed to balance performance and efficiency. Trained from scratch on over 450 GB of deduplicated and filtered mC4 and OSCAR23 from CulturaX using fairseq, PortBERT leverages byte-level BPE tokenizati

summary.core_problem: 现有葡萄牙语预训练模型多侧重规模或准确率，忽视训练与部署效率，缺乏平衡性能与效率的专用单语模型
summary.importance: 数据贡献+工程实现，发布了面向葡萄牙语的平衡型预训练模型家族
summary.technical_approach: 基于RoBERTa架构，采用字节级BPE分词，在450GB去重过滤的mC4和OSCAR23数据上预训练，支持GPU/TPU混合训练
summary.experiments: 发布base和large两个版本，在翻译版GLUE/SuperGLUE组成的ExtraGLUE基准上性能匹配或超过现有单语/多语模型，同时完整报告了训练、推理时间和微调吞吐量指标
summary.authors_note: 慕尼黑工业大学、弗莱堡大学团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Portuguese pretrained models mostly focus on scale or accuracy while neglecting training and deployment efficiency, lacking dedicated monolingual models balancing performance and efficiency
summary_en.importance: A combination of data contribution and engineering implementation that releases a balanced pretrained model family for Portuguese
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on RoBERTa architecture, adopts byte-level BPE tokenization, pretrains on 450GB deduplicated and filtered mC4 and OSCAR23 data, supports mixed GPU/TPU training
summary_en.experiments: Releases base and large variants, which match or outperform existing monolingual/multilingual models on ExtraGLUE (translated GLUE/SuperGLUE benchmark), and fully reports training, inference time and fine-tuning throughput metrics
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Technical University of Munich and University of Freiburg

recommendation.zh: 小语种专用预训练的增量工作，无通用预训练方法论创新，作为文献备查即可
recommendation.en: Incremental work on small-language dedicated pretraining with no general pretraining methodology insight; only for literature reference

paper.title: SAGE: A Novelty Gate for Efficient Memory Evolution in Agentic LLMs
paper.abstract: Agentic LLMs must continuously decide whether newly extracted facts should be added, merged with existing memories, or ignored, yet prior work has focused more on retrieval and storage than on principled write-side control. We frame memory evolution as a novelty-detection problem and propose SAGE, a Spherical Adaptive Gate for memory Evolution that scores candidate facts with a von Mises-Fisher-based density estimator over memory embeddings and routes them with an adaptive threshold that tracks

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic LLM 长期记忆写入阶段缺少原则化控制的问题，决定新事实应新增、忽略还是合并。
summary.importance: 这是 agent memory 的写路径优化工作。对基座预训练的直接价值有限，但它提醒一个常被忽略的点：memory 系统的瓶颈不只在 retrieval，也在 write-side filtering。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAGE，把 memory evolution 建模为 novelty detection。方法用基于 von Mises-Fisher 分布的密度估计器在记忆 embedding 空间中评估候选事实的新颖度，并用自适应阈值做三路路由：明显新颖则 ADD，明显冗余则 NOOP，边界样本才交给 LLM 做 merge，从而减少昂贵写时推理。
summary.experiments: 在 LoCoMo 上与 Mem0 等方法比较，摘要称在七个开源 backbone 上取得最佳平均 token-F1；在 GPT-4o-mini 上，add-phase API cost 降低 3.4×、延迟降低 2.5×，judge score 仅小幅下降；还可作为 A-Mem 的二值门控模块减少 merge 调用。没有预训练规模或通用建模结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the lack of principled write-side control in agentic LLM memory systems, deciding whether a new fact should be added, ignored, or merged.
summary_en.importance: This is a write-path optimization paper for agent memory. Its direct value to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but it highlights an often neglected point: memory bottlenecks are not only about retrieval, but also about write-side filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAGE formulates memory evolution as novelty detection. It uses a von Mises-Fisher-based density estimator over memory embeddings and an adaptive threshold to route candidate facts into ADD, NOOP, or LLM-based MERGE, reducing expensive write-time reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: On LoCoMo, it reportedly achieves the best average token-F1 against Mem0 across seven open-weight backbones. On GPT-4o-mini, it reduces add-phase API cost by 3.4× and latency by 2.5× with only a small judge-score drop. It can also serve as a binary gate for A-Mem. No pretraining-scale or general modeling conclusions are provided.

recommendation.zh: 写侧控制比检索更少被认真做，这点是它的价值；但方法更像工程门控，读摘要和成本表就够，不必深挖正文。
recommendation.en: Its useful point is that write-side control is underexplored relative to retrieval, but the method is mostly an engineering gate; the abstract and cost table are probably enough.

paper.title: Redundant or Necessary? A Benchmark for Detecting Redundant Steps in Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool use. However, existing evaluation protocols primarily focus on task success, overlooking a critical aspect of agent behavior: execution efficiency. In practice, agent trajectories often contain redundant steps that consume substantial resources while contributing little to task completion. In this work, we propose and formulate a new research area: \textbf{redundant step detectio

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent评估协议仅关注任务成功率，完全忽略执行效率维度。已有的粗粒度效率指标（延迟、token消耗、步长）无法识别轨迹中消耗资源但对任务完成无实质贡献的冗余步骤，也没有专门的基准支撑细粒度冗余步骤检测的研究与评估。
summary.importance: 填补了Agent轨迹细粒度步骤价值评估的空白。对于预训练研究，该基准可用于筛选高质量Agent轨迹训练数据，避免模型在SFT/RL阶段学习冗余推理模式，也可支撑Agent推理效率优化、降低部署成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RedundancyBench基准，包含200条完整Agent轨迹共8000余步，每一步通过多轮标注流程标记为冗余或必要。配套设计两级评估指标：面向粗粒度的轨迹级得分，以及面向细粒度检测能力的步骤级得分。在基准上测试了3种代表性的冗余步骤检测方法。
summary.experiments: 现有方法在该任务上表现普遍较差：性能最好的方法步骤级得分仅为24.88%，部分方法表现甚至不如随机猜测，说明冗余步骤检测难度较高，现有方案远未达到可用水平。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction部分的问题定义、基准构建与标注流程章节、实验部分的不同方法性能对比。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent evaluation protocols only focus on task success rate and ignore execution efficiency. Existing coarse-grained efficiency metrics (latency, token consumption, step length) cannot identify redundant steps in agent trajectories that consume computing resources but contribute nothing to task completion, and no dedicated benchmark supports research and evaluation of fine-grained redundant step detection.
summary_en.importance: This work fills the gap in fine-grained value evaluation of agent trajectory steps. For pretraining research, the benchmark can be used to filter high-quality agent trajectory training data, prevent models from learning redundant reasoning patterns during SFT/RL, and support optimization of agent inference efficiency to reduce deployment costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose RedundancyBench, which contains 200 complete agent trajectories with over 8,000 total steps. Each step is labeled as redundant or necessary through a multi-round annotation process. Two levels of evaluation metrics are provided: coarse-grained trajectory-level score and fine-grained step-level detection score. 3 representative redundant step detection methods are evaluated on the benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: Existing methods perform poorly on this task: the best-performing method only achieves 24.88% step-level score, while some methods perform worse than random guessing. The results indicate that redundant step detection is highly challenging and existing solutions are far from usable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem definition in Introduction, the benchmark construction and annotation pipeline section, and the performance comparison of different methods in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“agent 走冤枉路”做成可评测资产是对的；只需看任务定义与标注协议，24.88% 这个下限可当效率研究的 sanity check。

paper.title: ConMoE: Expert-Pool Consolidation via Prototype Reassignment for MoE Compression
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation but still require storing and serving all experts, making deployment memory-intensive. Existing post-training compression methods mainly shrink this cost by pruning experts or merging their weights. We formulate post-training MoE compression as expert-pool consolidation: retaining a smaller set of pretrained experts as reusable prototypes and deterministically remapping each original expert reference to one selected prototype.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MoE 部署里的一个很具体但常被混在一起的问题：稀疏激活降低了每 token 计算量，但并没有降低专家参数的存储和服务成本，因为整套 expert pool 仍然必须可寻址。作者把 post-training MoE 压缩重新表述为“expert-pool consolidation”：不是直接剪掉专家，或把多个专家做权重融合，而是在给定预算下保留一部分预训练专家作为 prototype，再把原始每个 expert slot 确定性地重映射到某个 prototype。这样把两个决策拆开了：一是保留哪些参数，二是原 router 看到的 expert 引用如何被表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身的直接影响有限，因为它不改变训练目标、路由学习或 MoE 扩展规律，主要是部署侧的后处理压缩方法。但它对 MoE 基座研究仍有两个启发。第一，它说明很多 expert 冗余并不需要通过再训练才能利用，单靠“保留+重映射”就能在一定压缩率下维持性能，这反过来提示预训练阶段可能存在较强的专家同质化。第二，它把“参数池”和“路由接口”解耦，这个视角对以后做可压缩 MoE、共享专家设计、局部跨层专家复用有参考价值。贡献量级更像是一个清晰的问题重述加一个稳健的 train-free 基线，而不是改变 MoE 训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个不训练的 prototype remapping 框架。作者先在单层或局部相邻层组成的 scope 内，把所有 routed experts 看成待压缩对象；给定压缩比例 rho，从原专家集合里选出一个较小的 prototype pool P，再为每个原始专家 e 指定一个映射 m(e) 到某个 prototype。压缩后的模型不改 router，不改 top-k 逻辑，也不改共享模块；只是当 router 选中原 expert slot 时，实际调用其对应 prototype。这样可以保持原有 router interface，不需要重新学习门控。

从 formulation 看，这接近一个带权代表点选择问题：每个原专家有重要性权重 w_e，每个原专家到候选 prototype 有表示代价 d(e,p)，目标是在预算约束下最小化总重映射代价。论文默认 prototype 必须来自已有 pretrained experts，而不是新合成专家；默认也不做权重更新或压缩后微调。作者把 post-hoc weight fusion 只作为诊断性分析，而不是主流程，这一点很重要，因为它让结果更能说明“纯重映射”本身的效果。

ConMoE 的设计还有两个边界条件。其一，允许 local cross-layer sharing，即相邻层在一个有限 scope 内共享 prototype，但不做全模型范围共享，原因是跨太远层的功能错配更严重。其二，预算可以在 scope 内非均匀分配，而不是每层硬性等比例压缩，这给了方法一定灵活性。论文的关键不在复杂算法，而在这个表示层面的拆分：压缩后逻辑上的 expert slot 数量不变，但物理存储的 prototype 数量减少；要真正拿到内存收益，需要 checkpoint 或 runtime 支持 prototype 共享去重。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段看，实验结论主要是定性的：在多个预训练 MoE 语言模型上，ConMoE 在匹配的 logical routed-expert budget 下，可以作为 pruning 和 merging 之外的可行替代；确定性重映射是最稳定的组成部分；更激进的跨层共享和事后权重融合则明显更依赖模型。论文还特别区分了“逻辑压缩”和“物理内存节省”：如果一个 prototype 被多个原 expert slot 复用，逻辑上只算一次，但实际节省内存要靠实现层支持。

由于提供的全文内容被截断，具体实验数字、模型规模、压缩比例下的困惑度或下游性能变化没有完整暴露，无法可靠复述。阅读时应重点核对：1）比较对象是否包含简单的 layer-wise pruning / merge baselines；2）不同 rho 下的 loss 或 benchmark 退化曲线；3）单层重映射与局部跨层共享的差异；4）prototype 选择准则和距离度量 d(e,p) 对结果的敏感性；5）是否在 Mixtral、DeepSeekMoE、Qwen-MoE、OLMoE 等不同架构上都保持一致趋势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，理解作者为什么坚持把“保留哪些专家”和“如何表示原 expert slot”拆开。再看方法部分里 prototype selection、reassignment cost、scope 设计这三块，判断它到底是一个新视角还是只是换名的聚类压缩。最后看实验表和消融，重点盯三件事：压缩率-性能曲线、跨层共享是否真的有益、weight fusion 为什么只适合作为诊断项。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果你做 MoE serving 或可压缩架构设计，再花时间看实现假设和 logical/physical saving 的区别。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific deployment bottleneck in MoE models: sparse routing reduces per-token FLOPs, but not the storage and serving cost of the expert pool, since all experts must remain addressable. Instead of treating post-training compression as pruning or weight merging, the authors recast it as expert-pool consolidation: keep a smaller subset of pretrained experts as prototypes, then deterministically remap every original expert slot to one retained prototype. This separates two decisions that are usually entangled: which expert parameters are stored, and how the router-facing expert references are represented after compression.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on pretraining is modest, since it does not change the training objective, routing dynamics, or MoE scaling behavior. Still, it is relevant to foundation-model research for two reasons. First, it suggests that a nontrivial amount of expert redundancy can be exploited without retraining, which is indirect evidence that pretrained MoE experts may be more interchangeable than their parameter count suggests. Second, the paper cleanly decouples the parameter pool from the routing interface, a useful perspective for future work on compressible MoE design, expert sharing, and local cross-layer reuse. The contribution is best viewed as a strong train-free compression framing and baseline, not as a new MoE training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ConMoE is a train-free prototype remapping framework. Within a layer or a bounded local scope of neighboring MoE layers, the routed experts are treated as the compressible object. Given a reduction ratio rho, the method selects a smaller prototype pool P from the original pretrained experts, then assigns each original expert e to a prototype m(e). The router is left unchanged: when it selects an original expert slot, execution is redirected to the assigned prototype. This preserves the original router interface and avoids relearning gating.

Formally, the setup resembles a weighted representative selection problem. Each original expert has an importance weight w_e, and each expert-prototype pair has a reassignment cost d(e,p). Under a budget on the number of retained prototypes, the goal is to minimize total weighted reassignment cost. In the default setting, prototypes must be existing pretrained experts rather than synthesized experts, and there is no post-compression finetuning. Post-hoc weight fusion is only used as a diagnostic sensitivity study, which is an important design choice because it isolates the effect of remapping itself.

Two design boundaries matter. First, the method allows local cross-layer sharing inside a bounded scope, but avoids model-wide sharing because distant layers are more likely to have incompatible expert functions. Second, the compression budget can be allocated non-uniformly across layers within a scope. The main novelty is not algorithmic complexity but the representational split: the logical set of router-visible expert slots stays intact, while the physically stored expert pool shrinks. Actual memory savings therefore depend on checkpoint or runtime support for deduplicated shared prototypes.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the main empirical claims are qualitative rather than fully numeric: across multiple pretrained MoE language models, ConMoE is a viable alternative to pruning and merging under matched logical routed-expert budgets; deterministic reassignment is the most stable component; broader cross-layer sharing and post-hoc weight fusion are more model-dependent. The paper also explicitly distinguishes logical compression from physical memory reduction: if one prototype serves multiple original expert slots, it only counts once logically, but real memory savings require implementation support.

Because the supplied content is truncated, the exact model sizes, compression ratios, perplexity changes, and downstream benchmark numbers are not fully available here. When reading the paper, the key checks are: whether the baselines include simple layer-wise pruning and merge methods; how performance degrades as rho increases; whether local cross-layer sharing helps consistently; how sensitive results are to the prototype selection rule and the distance metric d(e,p); and whether the trends hold across Mixtral-, DeepSeekMoE-, Qwen-MoE-, and OLMoE-style models.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the Introduction and Problem Formulation. The main value is the reframing: separating expert retention from router-facing representation. Then read the method section around prototype selection, reassignment cost, and scope design to see whether this is genuinely different from clustering-style compression. Finally, inspect the main tables and ablations with three questions in mind: the compression-performance curve, whether cross-layer sharing actually helps, and why weight fusion is treated as diagnostic rather than default. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. Spend more time only if you work on MoE serving or architecture design for compressibility.

recommendation.zh: 无需训练的MoE压缩是部署友好方向，ConMoE的原型重映射思路比简单剪枝更优雅。做MoE推理优化的团队应评估此方法。
recommendation.en: Train-free MoE compression is deployment-friendly; ConMoE's prototype remapping is more elegant than simple pruning. Teams doing MoE inference optimization should evaluate this approach.

paper.title: Access Sets Matter: Budgeting Expert Reads for Scalable Weight-Space Model Merging
paper.abstract: Weight-space model merging is usually formulated as an algebraic operation on checkpoints, yet at LLM scale the limiting resource is often the set of expert weights that must be read. We introduce MergePipe, a budget-aware execution layer that casts LLM merging as an \emph{expert access-set} problem: given a merge operator and a checkpoint family in a shared weight coordinate system, choose which expert delta blocks to access under an explicit I/O budget. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是大规模模型合并中的执行瓶颈：已有方法主要讨论 AVG、TIES、DARE 等合并规则如何组合权重，但在 LLM 尺度下，反复读取多个专家 checkpoint 的 I/O 成本会随专家数近似线性增长，常常比合并计算本身更限制迭代效率。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不是新的训练目标或合并算子，而是把 checkpoint family 看成一种 weight-space dataset 后，给出了一层可控的访问抽象。对持续预训练、领域专家合并、adapter/delta 管理、post-train 多分支回收有实际参考价值。它提醒一个容易被忽略的问题：当模型家族规模变大时，权重合并不只是代数操作，也是存储访问规划问题。
summary.technical_approach: MergePipe 将每个专家相对 base model 的 delta 按 tensor 和 block 切分，定义访问单元为 expert-tensor-block 三元组，并为每个单元赋予物理读取成本。合并时不再默认读取所有专家权重，而是在预算 B 下选择访问 mask A，只对选中的 delta block 执行给定合并算子。方法上分成 catalog、plan、execute 三步：catalog 记录参数块、成本和可选统计量；planner 用范数、sketch、coverage 或元数据分数做确定性 greedy 或 score-per-byte 选择；executor 只读取 mask 选中的专家块，并输出可重放 manifest。理论部分证明了三件事：执行读取不会超过预算；满预算且 A 为全 1 时恢复原始 full-read merge；对固定系数的 additive merge，遗漏更新误差可由未访问 delta 的加权范数上界控制。这个界不能直接覆盖 TIES、DARE 或 selected-only renormalization，因为这些算子的系数、符号投票或随机稀疏会随访问集合改变。
summary.experiments: 文中给出的主要结果是在 Qwen 和 Llama checkpoint family 上做预算扫描。MergePipe 报告可获得最高约一个数量级的 expert I/O 降低，并达到最高 11 倍速度提升；在代表性预算下，下游行为基本保持。满预算时结果与标准全量读取合并一致。实验价值主要在 speed-fidelity frontier：随着访问预算下降，I/O 和运行时间减少，但合并质量需要通过任务指标验证。已给出的全文片段没有展开具体任务表、block size、专家数量和各预算点精度，因此这些数字需要在实验节中核对。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 20–30 分钟即可。优先看 Budgeted Access Sets 中 access mask、non-anticipatory operator、Proposition 1/2；这部分决定了方法边界。然后看 MergePipe 的 catalog-plan-execute 设计和 manifest 机制，判断它是否能接入现有 checkpoint 管线。实验节重点看三类图表：预算比例与 I/O 的关系、预算比例与下游指标的关系、不同 block 粒度或 scoring rule 的消融。若关心模型合并质量，不必停留在理论误差界，因为它只严格适用于固定系数 additive merge；TIES/DARE 的有效性主要依赖经验结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets an execution bottleneck in large-scale model merging. Existing work mainly optimizes the merge rule, such as AVG, TIES, or DARE, while LLM-scale checkpoint families are often limited by the cost of reading expert weights. As the number of experts grows, full-read merge scripts become increasingly I/O-bound.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a new merge operator. It is an execution abstraction for treating expert deltas as a budgeted resource. This is relevant to continual pretraining, domain-expert consolidation, adapter and delta management, and post-training pipelines that maintain many related checkpoints. The useful lesson is that a checkpoint family behaves like a weight-space dataset, and accessing that dataset needs planning once the family becomes large.
summary_en.technical_approach: MergePipe partitions each expert delta relative to a shared base model into tensor blocks. Each access unit is an expert-tensor-block tuple with an associated physical read cost. A merge run chooses an access mask under an explicit budget, then applies the requested merge operator only to the selected delta blocks. The system follows a catalog-plan-execute loop: the catalog stores block metadata and optional statistics; the planner uses deterministic greedy or score-per-byte heuristics based on norms, sketches, coverage, or fallback metadata; the executor reads only selected blocks and emits a replayable manifest. The theory establishes budget soundness, full-budget consistency, and an omitted-update error bound for fixed-coefficient additive merges. The bound does not directly cover TIES, DARE, or selected-only renormalization, because masks can change coefficients, sign elections, random drops, or sparsification patterns.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments use Qwen and Llama checkpoint families with budget sweeps. MergePipe reports up to an order-of-magnitude reduction in expert I/O and up to 11x speedups, while preserving downstream behavior at representative budgets. Full-budget execution recovers the standard full-read merge. The main empirical object is the speed-fidelity curve: lower access budgets reduce I/O and runtime, but quality must be measured on downstream tasks. The supplied text does not include the detailed task tables, block sizes, expert counts, or exact accuracy numbers, so those should be checked in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Start with the access-mask formulation, the non-anticipatory operator requirement, and the two propositions in Budgeted Access Sets. Then read the catalog-plan-execute design and the manifest mechanism to see how the abstraction would fit into an existing checkpoint pipeline. In the experiments, focus on budget versus I/O, budget versus downstream metrics, and ablations over block granularity or scoring rules. The theoretical error bound is most useful for additive merges; for TIES and DARE, the empirical budget sweeps carry more weight.

recommendation.zh: 模型合并的I/O瓶颈是LLM规模下的实际痛点，MergePipe的访问集建模思路实用，重点看§3的误差界和§5的实验。
recommendation.en: The I/O bottleneck in model merging is a real pain point at LLM scale; MergePipe's access-set formulation is practical. Focus on §3 error bounds and §5 experiments.

paper.title: Head-Aware Key-Value Compression for Efficient Autoregressive Image Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) visual generation has achieved remarkable performance but suffers from high memory usage and low throughput, as it requires caching previously generated visual tokens. Recent research has shown that retaining only a few lines of cache tokens can maintain high-quality images while significantly reducing memory usage and improving throughput. However, these methods allocate a fixed budget to each attention head, overlooking the heterogeneity among attention heads, leading to su

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理 AR 图像生成里的 KV cache 开销问题。高分辨率图像会被展开成很长的视觉 token 序列，生成 1024×1024 图像时 KV cache 可超过 50GB。已有 LineAR 类方法发现视觉 token 主要关注相邻空间区域，因此保留少量行缓存即可。但它给每个 attention head 分配相同预算，忽略了不同 head 的注意力模式差异。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不在训练目标，而在 AR 视觉生成的推理侧可扩展性。它的启发点是：视觉 AR 模型的 head 功能分化比文本解码更受空间结构约束，KV 压缩不应只按 token 维度做统一裁剪，而应按 head 的局部性和全局性分配预算。这对统一多模态 AR 模型、视觉 tokenizer 后的长序列生成、以及高分辨率 native multimodal LM 的部署都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 HeadKV，是一个 training-free 的 head-aware KV cache 压缩流程。论文先分析 Lumina-mGPT-786 中不同层、不同 head 的 attention map，区分两类 head：local heads 主要看空间邻域，适合用小预算滑动窗口；global heads 负责长程依赖，例如物体结构和背景，需要保留更大的历史 token 集合。关键观察是：同一个输入内，一个 head 在不同生成位置上的注意力模式较稳定；但同一个 head 在不同输入之间可能变化。因此它不依赖离线统计或固定规则，而是在生成早期用基于注意力累积的阈值准则在线判定 head 类型。判定后，local heads 使用紧凑预算和 sliding-window 更新；global heads 使用更大预算，并配合 Stratified Token Eviction，在长历史中分层保留更有信息量的 token。与 LineAR 的主要区别是预算从 uniform per-head allocation 改为 input-adaptive per-head allocation。
summary.experiments: 论文在现有 AR 图像生成模型上验证 HeadKV，重点比较 KV cache 显存、推理吞吐和生成质量。引言明确给出的背景数字是：1024×1024 生成可带来超过 50GB 的 KV cache 压力。实验结论是 HeadKV 在保持图像质量的同时降低 KV cache 使用并提升吞吐。消融的核心应围绕三点看：head 类型在线判定是否稳定，local/global 非对称预算是否优于统一预算，STE 是否能比只保留空间邻域更好地恢复长程依赖。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中关于 local/global heads 的 attention map 分析，尤其是同一输入内 head 行为跨 token position 稳定、跨输入可变这一观察。方法部分重点看 head 分类阈值、预算分配和 Stratified Token Eviction 的实现细节。实验部分建议只看质量-显存-吞吐 trade-off 表，以及 local/global budget、STE、early-stage classification 的消融。对预训练研究员来说，最值得记下的是 head heterogeneity 在视觉 AR 序列中的表现，而不是具体工程参数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the KV-cache bottleneck in autoregressive image generation. High-resolution images are represented as long visual-token sequences, and generating a 1024×1024 image can require more than 50GB of KV cache. Prior methods such as LineAR exploit spatial locality and keep only a few recent image lines, but they assign the same cache budget to every attention head, which is inefficient when heads play different roles.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is inference scalability for visual AR models rather than pretraining itself. The useful lesson is that head specialization in visual AR decoding is strongly tied to image geometry. KV compression should not be a uniform token-level pruning rule; it should allocate memory according to whether a head behaves locally or globally. This matters for unified multimodal AR systems, high-resolution visual-token generation, and native multimodal LMs where image tokens create very long decoding sequences.
summary_en.technical_approach: HeadKV is a training-free, head-aware KV-cache compression pipeline. The paper analyzes attention maps in Lumina-mGPT-786 and separates heads into local heads and global heads. Local heads mostly attend to spatial neighborhoods and can use a small sliding-window cache. Global heads capture long-range dependencies such as object structure and background context, so they need a larger budget and a more selective retention policy. A key observation is that, for a fixed input, the attention pattern of a head is largely consistent across token positions, even though the same head may behave differently across inputs. HeadKV therefore classifies head types online during an early generation stage using a thresholded attention-accumulation criterion. It then applies compact sliding-window caching to local heads and a larger-budget Stratified Token Eviction strategy to global heads. The difference from uniform methods such as LineAR is input-adaptive, per-head budget allocation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate existing AR image-generation models along three axes: KV-cache memory, decoding throughput, and image quality. The introduction gives the deployment motivation: 1024×1024 generation can exceed 50GB of KV cache. The reported conclusion is that HeadKV reduces cache memory and improves throughput while preserving visual quality. The most informative ablations are expected to be the stability of online head classification, asymmetric local/global cache budgets versus uniform budgets, and the contribution of Stratified Token Eviction for retaining long-range visual dependencies.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the attention-map analysis in the introduction, especially the claim that head behavior is stable across token positions within one input but can vary across inputs. Then read the method details for the head-type criterion, cache-budget assignment, and Stratified Token Eviction. In the experiments, focus on the quality-memory-throughput trade-off table and the ablations for head classification, budget asymmetry, and STE. The main takeaway for pretraining researchers is the structure of head heterogeneity in visual AR sequences, not the exact cache hyperparameters.

recommendation.zh: 将 LLM 中常见的 Head-aware KV Cache 压缩思路迁移到了自回归图像生成（AR Vision）中，验证了视觉 token 同样存在局部/全局注意力头的异质性，做 AR Vision 效率优化的可看。
recommendation.en: Transfers the head-aware KV Cache compression idea from LLMs to autoregressive image generation, verifying the heterogeneity of local/global attention heads for visual tokens. Worth reading for AR Vision efficiency optimization.

paper.title: AgentStop: Terminating Local AI Agents Early to Save Energy in Consumer Devices

While remote, cloud-based agents offer scalability and ease of deployment, they raise privacy concerns, depend on network connectivity, and incur recurring API costs.
