summary.core_problem: 本地部署的LLM agent相比单次推理工作负载会大幅增加GPU功耗、温度和电池消耗，大量无效执行（失败重试等）造成显著算力浪费。
summary.importance: 首次系统测量本地消费级硬件上LLM agent的时间、token和能源开销，并提出早期终止机制来节省能源。
summary.technical_approach: 通过测量分析agentic执行相对于单次推理的资源开销，提出AgentStop框架——在消费设备上提前终止本地AI agent以节省能源。具体技术方案未在摘要详述。
summary.experiments: 测量结果表明agentic执行相比单次推理工作负载显著提高了GPU功耗、温度和电池消耗。具体终止效果数据未在摘要详述。
summary.authors_note: University of Massachusetts Amherst、Brave Software、Imperial College London。

summary_en.core_problem: Locally deployed LLM agents on consumer hardware incur significantly higher GPU power draw, temperature, and battery drain compared to single-inference workloads, with much compute wasted on failed retries and unsuccessful tasks.
summary_en.importance: First systematic measurement of time, token, and energy overhead of local LLM agents on consumer hardware, proposing an early termination mechanism to save energy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Measures and analyzes resource overhead of agentic execution vs. single inference, proposing the AgentStop framework for early termination of local AI agents on consumer devices.
summary_en.experiments: Measurements show agentic execution substantially increases GPU power, temperature, and battery drain compared to single-inference workloads. Specific termination effectiveness not detailed in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Massachusetts Amherst, Brave Software, Imperial College London.

recommendation.zh: 对本地LLM agent的能源开销进行了实测，是实用的工程参考，但不涉及LLM pretrain方法，对pretrain研究员无直接启发。
recommendation.en: Useful engineering reference on measured energy overhead of local LLM agents, but no relevance to LLM pretrain methodology.

paper.title: DimMem: Dimensional Structuring for Efficient Long-Term Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents require long-term memory to leverage information from past interactions. However, existing memory systems often face a fidelity--efficiency trade-off: raw dialogue histories are expensive, while flat facts or summaries may discard the structure needed for precise recall. We propose \textbf{DimMem}, a lightweight dimensional memory framework that represents each memory as an atomic, typed, and self-contained unit with explicit fields such as time, location, reaso

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent 长期记忆系统在保真度与效率之间的矛盾：原始对话历史太贵，扁平事实或摘要又丢失精确召回所需结构。
summary.importance: 这是轻量级 agent memory 设计工作。贡献在于提出结构化、维度化的记忆单元表示，并展示它能在较低 token 成本下维持较好召回。对预训练研究员的直接启发有限，但对外部记忆表示设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DimMem，把每条记忆表示为原子化、带类型、字段自包含的单元，显式包含时间、地点、原因、目的、关键词等维度。基于这些字段做 dimension-aware retrieval、记忆更新和选择性上下文回填。方法本质上是把自由文本记忆压成结构化 schema，以换取检索效率和更可控的召回。
summary.experiments: 在 LoCoMo-10 和 LongMemEval-S 上分别达到 81.43% 和 78.20% 总体准确率，并在 LoCoMo 上把单次查询 token 成本降低 24%。摘要还提到维度化记忆抽取具有一定鲁棒性。需要进一步看与哪些 lightweight memory baselines 比、是否牺牲开放式生成质量，以及 schema 抽取错误如何传播到后续检索。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自厦门大学、上海科技大学。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the fidelity-efficiency trade-off in long-term memory for LLM agents: raw dialogue history is expensive, while flat facts or summaries often lose the structure needed for precise recall.
summary_en.importance: This is a lightweight agent-memory design paper. Its contribution is a structured, dimensional memory unit that improves retrieval efficiency while preserving useful recall structure. The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is a reasonable reference for external memory representation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: DimMem represents each memory as an atomic, typed, self-contained unit with explicit fields such as time, location, reason, purpose, and keywords. These fields support dimension-aware retrieval, memory updates, and selective context reinjection. Conceptually, it compresses free-form memory into a structured schema to gain efficiency and controllability.
summary_en.experiments: On LoCoMo-10 and LongMemEval-S, it reports 81.43% and 78.20% overall accuracy, respectively, while reducing per-query token cost on LoCoMo by 24%. The abstract also claims robust dimensional memory extraction. The main things to verify are the strength of lightweight baselines, whether open-ended generation quality degrades, and how extraction errors propagate into retrieval failures.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Xiamen University and ShanghaiTech University.

recommendation.zh: 是外部记忆 schema 设计，不是基座方法；看结果表确认结构化字段是否真优于摘要记忆，正文可不读。
recommendation.en: This is external-memory schema design, not a base-model paper; just check whether structured fields really beat summary memory in the main table and skip the rest.

paper.title: SOMA: Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving via Small Language Model
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-turn dialogue settings where preserving conversational context across turns is essential. A standard serving practice concatenates the full dialogue history at every turn, which reliably maintains coherence but incurs substantial cost in latency, memory, and API expenditure, especially when queries are routed to large proprietary models. Existing approaches often struggle to balance the trade-off between response quality and efficie

summary.core_problem: 多轮对话线上服务通常每一轮都要把全量历史拼回去给大模型，导致重复计算、延迟和成本随轮次线性上升；但直接把后续轮次交给小模型又会因早期上下文“定锚”而逐步漂移。论文要解决的是：在不每轮调用大模型、且不牺牲多轮一致性的前提下，让小模型在单个会话的“局部行为流形”上逼近大模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏系统/Serving 与会话内自适应蒸馏。价值点在于两件事：1）把“会话内分布是局部的”明确成可操作的建模假设（local manifold approximation），提供了一种 session-level 的轻量对齐思路；2）给出一个经验观察：多轮对话 token 分布呈长尾，早期轮次更长且信息密度更高，后期轮次更短但强依赖早期锚点——这对做长上下文训练数据配比、对话压缩/记忆模块的评估设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
SOMA（Soft-prompts for lOcal Manifold Approximation）是一个三阶段会话内适配框架，目标是用少量大模型调用，把小模型“拉到”当前会话诱导的局部区域。
1）Soft prompt tuning：在会话早期轮次上，为小模型学习软提示，刻意寻找能放大“小模型 vs 大模型”语义行为差异的方向（文中表述为最大化语义发散/behavioral divergence）。直觉是：先找到最容易出错、最能暴露差距的局部切向方向，后续对齐更高效。
2）Localized fine-tuning：用少量输入-输出对（由大模型在早期轮次产生/标注）对小模型做局部微调（文中提到 localized LoRA），让小模型在该会话的局部流形上模仿大模型。这里的关键取舍是“会话内局部拟合”而不是“全局蒸馏”：牺牲跨会话泛化，换取单会话的快速贴合与成本下降。
3）Efficient inference：推理阶段尽量做到 prompt-free（软提示/LoRA 已内化），并结合 extractive summary 来降低输入长度；同时用一个基于余弦相似度的 gate 做模型切换，并配 rollback 机制监测潜在 topic shift，一旦偏离局部区域就回退到大模型以保质量。
整体上它不是在压缩 KV-cache 或做 attention 复用，而是把“后续轮次的生成”转化为“会话内小模型对大模型的局部模仿问题”。
summary.experiments:
给定的全文片段未包含实验设置与具体数字（模型规模、数据集、成本节省比例、质量指标、消融等），因此无法基于全文复述关键结果。可从论文的实验部分重点核对：
- 质量：与全程大模型相比的胜率/偏好评测、以及多轮一致性指标（是否随轮次漂移）。
- 成本：大模型调用次数减少比例、端到端延迟、token 计费节省。
- 消融：仅路由到小模型 vs SOMA；无 soft-prompt 探索/无 localized LoRA/无 summary/无 rollback 的影响；gate 阈值敏感性。
- 长尾现象：不同域对话的 turn-level token 分布统计是否稳定，以及与性能/切换点的关系。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- Introduction：把“长尾 turn 分布 + 早期定锚”这个经验事实读清楚，这是方法成立的前提。
- 方法部分三阶段：重点看 soft prompt 如何定义“语义发散/最大差异方向”，以及 localized LoRA 的数据来源与预算（每会话需要多少大模型样本）。
- 推理策略：cosine gate 与 rollback 的触发条件，决定线上可控性。
- 实验：优先看成本-质量曲线与消融，判断它到底是“少量大模型调用换大幅节省”，还是把质量风险转移到回退机制上。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-turn chat serving commonly resends the full dialogue history to a large model at every turn, causing redundant compute, latency, and cost growth with conversation length. Simply handing later turns to a small model degrades coherence because early turns anchor the session and later turns depend heavily on that context. The paper targets session-level efficiency: adapt a small model to approximate a large model’s behavior within the local region induced by the early turns, so later turns can be served cheaply without losing consistency.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a serving/system paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is indirect: (1) it operationalizes a “session-local distribution/manifold” assumption and turns it into a lightweight, per-session alignment recipe; (2) it highlights an empirical long-tail pattern in turn-level token counts—early turns are long and information-dense, later turns are shorter yet more context-dependent—which can inform how we design dialogue pretraining mixes and how we evaluate memory/compression mechanisms beyond naive truncation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SOMA (Soft-prompts for lOcal Manifold Approximation) is a three-stage per-session adaptation pipeline.
1) Soft-prompt tuning: using early turns, learn soft prompts for the small model that intentionally expose directions where the small and large models diverge most in semantic behavior (maximizing behavioral/semantic divergence). The idea is to find the most diagnostic local directions before aligning.
2) Localized fine-tuning: collect a small set of input–output pairs from the large model in the early session and perform localized adaptation of the small model (via LoRA) to match the large model within this session-specific region. The key design choice is local, session-scoped fitting instead of global distillation.
3) Efficient inference: run the adapted small model in a prompt-free manner, feed it an extractive summary to reduce input length, and use a cosine-similarity gate to decide when to switch/rollback to the large model upon topic shift.
Overall, the method reframes multi-turn serving as session-level local imitation rather than cache reuse or generic routing.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experimental section or any concrete numbers (model sizes, datasets, cost/latency reductions, win rates, ablations). As a result, no faithful quantitative summary can be produced from the given content. When reading the paper, verify: (i) quality vs full large-model baseline across turns (drift/coherence), (ii) reduction in large-model calls and token-billing savings, (iii) ablations for soft-prompt search / localized LoRA / summarization / rollback, and (iv) robustness of the reported long-tail turn-length statistics across domains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 minutes):
- Intro: understand the empirical premise (turn-length long tail + early-turn anchoring).
- Method: focus on how “max semantic divergence” is defined/optimized for soft prompts, and the per-session budget (how many large-model samples are needed for LoRA).
- Inference control: cosine gate and rollback conditions—this determines operational risk.
- Experiments: prioritize cost–quality trade-off curves and ablations to see whether savings come from true small-model takeover or frequent fallbacks.

recommendation.zh: 思路比结果更值得看：把多轮会话当局部分布做在线小模型接管，这个 prior 值得记；先看 cost-quality 曲线和 topic drift 失败案例。
recommendation.en: The idea matters more than the numbers: treating a conversation as a local distribution for on-the-fly small-model takeover is a useful prior; inspect the cost-quality curves and topic-drift failures first.

paper.title: Towards Generation-Efficient Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Uncertainty estimation is important for deploying LLMs in high-stakes applications such as healthcare and finance, where hallucinations can appear fluent and plausible while being factually incorrect, making it difficult for users to judge whether an output should be trusted. Existing methods require one or more full autoregressive generations to estimate uncertainty, which introduces substantial inference cost and often delays uncertainty assessment. In this paper, we investigate whether effect

summary.core_problem: 在不做（或少做）自回归生成的前提下，能否对 LLM 最终输出的可靠性/不确定性做出有效估计，从而把“不确定”尽量提前暴露出来，降低多次采样或完整生成带来的延迟与算力成本。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接改动不多，但对“生成式模型的置信度信号来自哪里”给了一个可操作的分解：把不确定性估计视为沿解码过程的 early estimation，并展示了仅看部分 token 甚至只看输入也能接近单次完整生成的不确定性质量。对训练侧的启发在于：logit 尺度（softmax 之前的证据强度）可能是比概率熵更稳定的可迁移信号；同时用“生成得到的内部信号”给一个轻量模型做伪标注，提供了一条把推理时信号蒸馏回前置模块的路径。
summary.technical_approach:
论文先给不确定性估计方法按“观察到多少生成信息”做了谱系：多次生成（disagreement）、单次完整序列（序列熵/证据分数/隐状态特征）、部分生成、仅输入。
核心方法有两个：
1) Logit Magnitude（部分生成）：在每个解码步 t 取 logits 向量的 L2 范数作为 token 级不确定性/证据强度指标（直觉是 softmax 会抹平绝对尺度，而 logits 的幅值保留了模型‘证据强弱’信息）。然后对已生成前缀做聚合：不是简单平均，而是取 top-M 个“最有信息量”的 token 分数做聚合，避免长文本里大量平庸 token 稀释信号。并配合自适应 early-stop：当估计已足够稳定/达到阈值时提前停止继续生成，用更少 token 得到序列级不确定性。
2) MetaUE（输入-only）：用冻结的预训练 encoder + 小 MLP，从 prompt 直接预测 Logit Magnitude 的序列级分数。训练时不需要人工不确定性标签，而是用 Logit Magnitude（来自部分/完整生成）作为伪标签，把“生成阶段才能看到的信号”蒸馏成“生成前就能预测”的模块。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖通用与医疗域数据集、不同 LLM 家族与规模，并包含 MoE 架构的验证。主要结论是：
- 部分生成的 Logit Magnitude 在显著减少生成 token 的情况下，能给出与单次完整生成方法相近的排序/区分能力（论文主张其在低生成成本下仍具竞争力）。
- 输入-only 的 MetaUE 在零生成成本下仍能提供可用的不确定性估计，作为部署时的前置风险提示。
给出的摘要片段未包含具体指标口径（如 AUROC/PR-AUC、与 baselines 的差值、平均节省 token 比例等）与详细数字；精读时需要从实验章节核对：不同任务上“节省多少生成长度”对应“性能掉多少”。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按三个点读：
1) 方法动机与定义：看他们为何选 logits 的幅值而不是熵/最大概率，token 级到序列级的聚合为何用 top-M（对应哪些失败模式）。
2) early-stop 机制：阈值/稳定性判据如何设定，是否对不同模型/温度/采样策略敏感。
3) MetaUE 训练细节：伪标签来自“部分生成还是完整生成”、prompt encoder 选型、训练数据分布与跨域泛化。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住主线；若要复现或迁移到自家模型，需要额外精读实验设置与超参。

summary_en.core_problem: How to estimate an LLM’s output uncertainty without paying the full cost of autoregressive decoding—ideally from a short prefix, or even from the prompt alone—so uncertainty can be surfaced early and cheaply.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it sharpens a practical question that feeds back into modeling: where do reliable confidence signals live during decoding? The paper argues that much of the useful signal is concentrated early and that the absolute scale of logits (pre-softmax) can act as a robust “evidence strength” feature. The prompt-only distillation (using generation-derived pseudo-labels) is also a reusable pattern: convert expensive, generation-time internal signals into a cheap pre-generation predictor.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper frames uncertainty estimation as an early-estimation problem along the AR trajectory and organizes methods by how much generation they observe (multi-sample, single full sequence, partial generation, input-only).
Two main components:
1) Logit Magnitude (partial generation): at each step, compute the L2 norm of the logits vector as a token-level score. Aggregate to a sequence-level uncertainty using a top-M pooling over the prefix (to focus on the most informative steps rather than averaging everything). Add an adaptive early-stop rule so the estimator can stop decoding once the uncertainty estimate is deemed sufficient.
2) MetaUE (input-only): a lightweight meta-model (frozen pretrained encoder + small MLP head) predicts the Logit Magnitude score directly from the prompt. Training uses Logit Magnitude as pseudo-labels, distilling a decoding-time estimator into a zero-generation predictor.
summary_en.experiments: They report experiments across general and medical datasets, multiple model families/sizes, and include MoE models. The headline claim is that partial-generation Logit Magnitude remains competitive with full-generation single-pass baselines while using fewer generated tokens, and that MetaUE provides usable uncertainty at zero decoding cost. The provided excerpt does not include the exact metrics (e.g., AUROC/PR-AUC), token savings, or per-dataset numbers; those need to be pulled from the main experiment tables/figures in the full paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on: (1) the justification for logit-scale features vs entropy/probability-based scores; (2) the top-M aggregation choice and what failure modes it addresses; (3) the early-stop criterion and its sensitivity to sampling settings; (4) MetaUE training details—pseudo-label source, encoder choice, and cross-domain generalization. ~30–45 minutes to get the core idea; longer if you want to port it to a different decoding stack.

recommendation.zh: 将不确定性估计转化为早期估计问题，探索了仅用 partial generation 甚至 input-only 预测不确定性的方法，对降低可信 LLM 部署成本有启发，关注 Serving 效率的同学可看。
recommendation.en: Formulates uncertainty estimation as an early estimation problem, exploring methods to predict uncertainty using only partial generation or input-only information; inspiring for reducing the deployment cost of trustworthy LLMs, worth reading for those focused on Serving efficiency.

paper.title: RPRA: Predicting an LLM-Judge for Efficient but Performant Inference

summary.core_problem: 如何在不额外调用昂贵 LLM/agentic judge 的情况下，预先（pre-hoc）预测“如果我回答/行动，judge 会给我打多少分”，从而在小模型上实现可靠的自我质量控制与路由（能答好就本地答，没把握就升级到大模型）？论文将其形式化为 Predict-Answer/Act (PA) 与 Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer/Act (RPRA) 两种范式，并研究小模型为何普遍校准差（过度自信/不自信）以及如何修正。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练本身不是直接算法贡献，但对“训练后阶段的自评能力/校准、以及小模型可靠性”有现实启发：
- 提出把 judge 分数当作可学习的中间变量（self-evaluation target），用来做推理时的动态路由与成本控制。
- 揭示小模型在自评上的系统性 miscalibration，提示仅靠规模缩小+蒸馏并不能保证可靠性，需要显式的校准/自评训练信号。
- 方法上用两条低门槛路径：无需训练的 report card（基于历史评测汇总）与需要训练的 hindsight trick 监督微调，为构建“自知之明”能力提供工程可行方案。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 范式定义：
- PA：模型在生成答案前，先输出对“judge 将如何评分”的预测（可视为质量/置信度代理），再决定是否作答或路由。
- RPRA：在 PA 基础上加入“先推理再预测、再推理再回答/行动”的两段式结构，意图提升预测质量与最终回答质量。
2) 三种实现路径：tabula rasa（零样本）、ICL、SFT。
3) 校准改进方法 A：Report Card（无需训练）。通过在多个数据集上用 judge 评估模型历史表现，取 modal judge ratings 形成“该模型在不同任务上的典型表现描述”，作为额外上下文喂给模型，帮助其在新问题上更合理地预测自身得分。
4) 校准改进方法 B：Fine-tune for prediction（无需 report card token 成本）。构造训练数据时使用 hindsight trick：先让模型/系统产生回答，再用 judge 打分，把分数回填为监督标签，对模型做 SFT，使其学会从输入直接预测将来的 judge 分数，从而实现 PA。
5) 评测覆盖：多尺寸多家族模型（MobileLLM 0.9B、Llama 3.2 1B/3B、Llama 3.1 8B、Llama 3.3 70B、GPT OSS 20B/120B、DeepSeek Distilled Qwen 14B/32B/70B、Llama 4 Scout），比较大模型（尤其 reasoning model）与小模型在自评能力上的差异。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的核心实验结论：
- 大模型（尤其带推理能力的模型）在零样本下就能较好预测 judge 分数；小模型普遍 miscalibration（过度自信或过度保守）。
- Report card 能显著提升小模型预测准确性，且适用于闭源模型；但会引入额外上下文 token 成本。
- 用 hindsight trick + SFT 直接训练“分数预测器”可在不引入 report card 的情况下取得较强预测表现，推理更省。
- 现象观察：模型在更难的问题上反而表现出更强的 self-awareness（更能意识到自己可能答不好），暗示“难度”本身是可用信号。
注：你提供的全文片段未包含各数据集上的具体指标数值、相关系数/校准误差、以及 RPRA 相对 PA 的定量收益表，因此无法可靠复述具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30~45 分钟）：
1) 先看 PA/RPRA 的任务定义与输出格式（决定它到底是在学什么信号：分数、等级、还是偏好）。
2) 重点看 report card 的构造流程：用哪些数据集、如何汇总 modal rating、report card 文本长什么样；这决定其可迁移性与 token 成本。
3) 看 hindsight trick 的数据生成与 SFT 目标：标签噪声来自 judge，本质是“用 judge 蒸馏一个自评头”。
4) 对比不同模型尺寸的校准曲线/误差分析（若正文/附录有 reliability diagram、ECE 等），理解小模型 miscalibration 的模式。
5) 若只想抓结论：读 Introduction + 方法部分 + 主要结果图表，附录可按需查 judge 可靠性与多 judge 投票设置（作者提到 judge 单独评估时质量较差，暗示需要更贵的评估配置）。

summary_en.core_problem: How can an LLM predict—before generating an answer—how an LLM/agentic judge would rate that answer, enabling cheap reliability control and routing (answer locally when confident; escalate otherwise) without paying the full cost of running a judge? The paper formalizes this as Predict-Answer/Act (PA) and Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer/Act (RPRA), and studies why small models are poorly calibrated in such self-assessment and how to fix it.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for foundation-model training pipelines and small-model deployment: it treats judge scores as a learnable intermediate variable for self-evaluation, exposing systematic miscalibration in small models (over/under-confidence) and showing two practical remedies—contextual “report cards” (no training) and hindsight-based supervised fine-tuning (training-based, cheaper inference). The work suggests that scaling down or distillation alone does not yield reliable self-awareness; explicit calibration/self-eval signals may be required in post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Paradigms:
- PA: predict the judge score for the would-be response, then answer/act (or route).
- RPRA: add a reasoning step before prediction and another before answering, aiming to improve both score prediction and final output.

Implementation regimes: zero-shot, in-context learning, and supervised fine-tuning.

Calibration fixes:
1) Report card (training-free): build a textual performance summary from a model’s historical judge-evaluated results across multiple datasets, using modal judge ratings to describe typical strengths/weaknesses; prepend this to prompts so the model can condition its self-score prediction on known performance.
2) Fine-tuning for prediction (report-card-free at inference): use the hindsight trick to relabel examples with judge scores after observing responses, then SFT models to directly predict the judge score from the prompt, enabling PA without extra report-card tokens.

Model suite: broad range from ~0.9B to 120B/70B-class models (MobileLLM, Llama 3.x variants, GPT OSS, DeepSeek distilled Qwen variants, Llama 4 Scout) to compare size effects on self-evaluation.
summary_en.experiments:
Main reported outcomes:
- Large models, especially reasoning-oriented ones, can predict judge scores reasonably well even zero-shot; small models are typically miscalibrated.
- Report cards substantially improve small-model score prediction and are applicable even to closed models, at the cost of extra context tokens.
- Hindsight-trick SFT yields strong prediction performance without report cards, improving inference efficiency.
- An observed trend is stronger self-awareness on harder queries, implying difficulty is a useful latent signal.
Note: the provided excerpt does not include the key quantitative tables/metrics (e.g., calibration error, correlations, per-dataset deltas), so exact numbers cannot be stated reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the formal PA/RPRA definitions and output formats—what exactly is being predicted (scalar score, ordinal rating, etc.).
2) Study how report cards are constructed (datasets used, aggregation via modal ratings, prompt template) and estimate the token overhead.
3) Examine the hindsight-trick data pipeline and SFT objective; conceptually it is “distilling a judge into a self-eval head.”
4) Focus on calibration analyses by model size (look for reliability diagrams/ECE-style metrics if present).
5) If time-limited: Introduction + Methods + main results figures; consult appendices for judge reliability and multi-judge voting, since the paper notes single-judge evaluation can be noisy/weak.

recommendation.zh: 把judge分数当可学习中间变量做路由很实用，且点破小模型自评系统性失准；建议只看校准诊断与hindsight监督那部分。
recommendation.en: Practical take: learn the judge score as a latent for routing, and the miscalibration analysis is the real signal; skim calibration diagnostics + hindsight supervision.

paper.title: You Only Judge Once: Multi-response Reward Modeling in a Single Forward Pass
paper.abstract: We present a discriminative multimodal reward model that scores all candidate responses in a single forward pass. Conventional discriminative reward models evaluate each response independently, requiring multiple forward passes, one for each potential response. Our approach concatenates multiple responses with separator tokens and applies cross-entropy over their scalar scores, enabling direct comparative reasoning and efficient N-way preference learning. The multi-response design also yields up

summary.core_problem: 解决传统判别式奖励模型（Reward Model）需要对每个候选回复进行独立前向传播导致的计算效率低下和缺乏全局对比的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种单次前向传播评估多个回复的架构，实现了 N 倍的推理加速，并构建了两个新的多回复奖励评估基准。
summary.technical_approach: 使用分隔符 token 将多个候选回复拼接在一起输入模型，并在它们的标量分数上应用交叉熵损失，从而实现直接的比较推理和高效的 N-way 偏好学习。
summary.experiments: 构建了 MR^2Bench-Image 和 MR^2Bench-Video 两个基准，包含来自多个模型的回复和众包人类偏好判断，证明了该方法在效率和 N-way 评估上的优势。
summary.authors_note: 来自华盛顿大学 Ranjay Krishna 团队，专注于多模态与高效学习。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the computational inefficiency and lack of global comparative context in conventional discriminative reward models that require independent forward passes for each candidate response.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an architecture to score multiple responses in a single forward pass, achieving N-times inference speedup and introducing two new multi-response reward benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Concatenates multiple candidate responses with separator tokens, processes them in a single pass, and applies cross-entropy over their scalar scores to enable direct comparative reasoning and N-way preference learning.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs MR^2Bench-Image and MR^2Bench-Video using responses from multiple models and crowdsourced human judgments, demonstrating advantages in efficiency and N-way evaluation.
summary_en.authors_note: From Ranjay Krishna's lab at UW, focusing on multimodal and efficient learning.

recommendation.zh: 将 pairwise RM 扩展为 N-way 拼接单次前向，既省算力又引入了全局对比上下文，值得在 RLHF pipeline 中快速验证。
recommendation.en: Extends pairwise RM to N-way concatenation in a single pass, saving compute while adding global comparative context; worth a quick ablation in RLHF pipelines.

paper.title: On The Application of Linear Attention in Multimodal Transformers

summary.core_problem: 多模态 Transformer（尤其视觉 token + 文本 token）序列更长，标准 softmax attention 的 O(N^2) 计算/显存开销成为扩展瓶颈。线性注意力（Linear Attention, LA）虽在单模态中被研究较多，但在多模态预训练（如 CLIP/OpenCLIP 范式）里能否在保持性能的同时获得可观效率收益仍缺少系统验证。
summary.importance: 多模态模型的 token 数往往由高分辨率视觉 patch 主导，N 很容易上千，二次复杂度直接限制训练吞吐与可用分辨率/上下文。若 LA 在多模态预训练中能稳定工作并遵循类似 scaling law，将为更长序列、更大 batch 或更高分辨率提供直接的算力杠杆。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用可分解核将注意力从 softmax(QK^T)V 改写为线性形式：用特征映射 φ 使得相似度 f(q,k)=φ(q)^Tφ(k)，从而把计算重排为 O(ND^2)。具体实现采用仿射核 f(x)=1+x，并指出其潜在问题：若 q·k<-1 会产生负权重，因此先对 Q、K 做归一化以保证内积落在 [-1,1]，使核输出非负。进一步分析发现，带标准分母归一化（类似把权重“归一到和为 1”）会随序列长度增长导致注意力矩阵过度平滑（论文用 Figure 1 展示），削弱显著性与梯度信号；因此提出在已对 Q、K 预归一化的前提下，去掉分母项，改用不做该归一化的形式以缓解随长度增长的“分布变平”问题，从而提升可训练性与表达能力。整体贡献是：在 OpenCLIP 训练框架下，把 LA 作为标准 attention 的替代模块，并系统评估其性能与效率，以及与模型规模的 scaling 行为。
summary.experiments: 在 LAION-400M 上用 OpenCLIP 预训练 ViT-S/16、ViT-B/16、ViT-L/16，并以 ImageNet-21K zero-shot accuracy 做验证对比。论文报告 LA 相对标准 attention 显著降低计算开销，同时保持有竞争力的零样本精度；并观察到 LA 与标准 attention 呈现相近的“精度-模型规模”scaling 趋势（即扩大模型时的收益曲线形态类似）。
summary.reading_guide: must_read（精读）：(1) Background 中标准 attention 与 LA 的推导（从 softmax 到 φ 分解与重排），明确复杂度从 O(N^2D) 到 O(ND^2) 的前提与代价。 (2) Model 章节：仿射核 f(x)=1+x 的数值问题、Q/K 归一化约束、以及“去掉分母”这一关键改动；重点看 Figure 1（过度平滑现象的可视化）并理解其对梯度/表达性的影响。 (3) 实验部分：不同 ViT 尺寸下的 zero-shot 精度对比与效率指标，验证“性能接近 + 省算力 + scaling law 类似”。skim（泛读）：读 Introduction+贡献点；快速看 LA 公式重排与仿射核的处理（归一化 + 去分母的动机）；然后直接看实验主结果（ImageNet-21K zero-shot 与训练/推理效率对比）即可把握结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者的关键洞察是：在多模态长序列下，LA 的线性复杂度优势更“刚需”，但简单替换核会带来数值与训练动态问题；通过 Q/K 预归一化保证非负，再通过去掉分母缓解长度增长导致的过平滑，从而让 LA 在 CLIP 式预训练中更可用，并给出系统化的规模与效率验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal Transformers face severe scalability limits because standard softmax attention is quadratic in sequence length, and multimodal inputs often include hundreds to thousands of visual tokens plus text. While Linear Attention (LA) is well-studied in unimodal settings, its viability for multimodal pretraining (e.g., CLIP-style) lacks systematic validation.
summary_en.importance: In multimodal models, token counts are frequently dominated by high-resolution visual patches, making O(N^2) attention a major training/inference bottleneck. If LA can preserve competitive performance while reducing complexity to linear in N, it enables longer contexts, higher resolutions, or larger batches under the same compute budget, and provides a clearer path for scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper replaces softmax attention with a kernelized linear form using a decomposable feature map φ such that f(q,k)=φ(q)^Tφ(k), allowing associative reordering to achieve O(ND^2) computation. Concretely, it uses an affine kernel f(x)=1+x. Because affine kernels can yield negative scores when q·k<-1, the method pre-normalizes Q and K so dot products lie in [-1,1], ensuring non-negative kernel outputs. The authors further argue that the standard normalization denominator (making weights sum to one) causes attention to become increasingly uniform as sequence length grows, leading to over-smoothing and weaker gradient signals; they therefore propose omitting this denominator given the bounded, pre-normalized scores. Figure 1 visualizes the over-smoothing effect and the improvement from the modified formulation. The work integrates this LA variant into OpenCLIP-style multimodal training and evaluates accuracy/efficiency and scaling behavior.
summary_en.experiments: ViT-S/16, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16 are pretrained on LAION-400M within the OpenCLIP framework, with validation via ImageNet-21K zero-shot accuracy. Results indicate substantial compute savings versus standard attention while maintaining competitive zero-shot performance, and LA exhibits similar accuracy–model size scaling trends to standard attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: must_read (deep dive): (1) Background derivations: softmax attention vs LA factorization and the exact condition for reducing O(N^2D) to O(ND^2). (2) Model section: affine kernel pitfalls, Q/K normalization, and the key change of removing the denominator; focus on Figure 1 to understand over-smoothing and its training implications. (3) Experiments: compare zero-shot accuracy and efficiency across ViT sizes to validate “competitive performance + efficiency + similar scaling laws.” skim (high-level): read Intro/contributions, glance at the LA reordering and the affine-kernel fixes (normalization + no denominator), then jump to the main experimental results (ImageNet-21K zero-shot and efficiency comparisons).
summary_en.authors_note: The central message is that LA’s linear-in-N advantage is especially compelling for multimodal long sequences, but naive LA substitutions can introduce numerical and optimization issues. By bounding dot products via Q/K normalization and mitigating length-induced over-smoothing by dropping the denominator, the paper makes LA more practical for CLIP-style multimodal pretraining and supports the claim with scaling and efficiency evidence.

recommendation.zh: 看训练吞吐-精度曲线与分辨率/序列长度的 scaling 部分即可；若结果站得住，LA 可能是多模态预训最便宜的算力杠杆。
recommendation.en: Read the throughput–accuracy curves and the resolution/sequence-length scaling section; if it holds up, linear attention is one of the cheapest compute levers for multimodal pretraining.

summary.core_problem: LLM RL后训练普遍默认需要严格on-policy数据，experience replay在LLM RL中被忽视，推高了生成开销。
summary.importance: 系统性挑战LLM RL的on-policy教条，把经典RL的replay buffer概念带回LLM后训练，直接影响RL训练成本。
summary.technical_approach: 将replay buffer设计形式化为stale方差、样本多样性与生成开销的三方权衡，给出设计准则并做系统性实验。
summary.experiments: 精心设计的replay buffer在不降性能（部分场景略升）前提下大幅降低推理计算，且保持policy entropy。具体模型/数据规模摘要未详。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Taco Cohen、Julia Kempe、Remi Munos，经典RL/深度学习理论背景，分析通常比较严谨。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM RL post-training defaults to strict on-policy sampling, ignoring experience replay and paying high generation cost.
summary_en.importance: Challenges the on-policy dogma in LLM RL and reintroduces classic replay-buffer design, with direct cost implications.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes replay buffer design as trade-off among staleness-induced variance, sample diversity, and generation cost; systematic empirical study.
summary_en.experiments: Well-designed replay buffer drastically cuts inference compute without degrading (sometimes improving) performance, while preserving policy entropy.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Taco Cohen, Julia Kempe, Remi Munos—strong RL/DL theory lineage, analysis tends to be rigorous.

recommendation.zh: 直接打脸'LLM RL必须严格on-policy'的默认做法，若结论稳住应该立刻在internal RL pipeline里试replay buffer，这是省rollout算力的真问题。重点看staleness-variance的权衡曲线。
recommendation.en: Directly pushes back on the 'strict on-policy' default in LLM RL; if results hold, worth trying replay buffers in internal RL pipelines to save rollout compute. Focus on the staleness-variance trade-off curves.

paper.title: Reason Only When Needed: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Model-Internal Uncertainty

summary.core_problem: 现有 Generative Reward Model（GRM）在推理增强中普遍“对所有输入都强制 CoT”，导致不必要的算力/时延；同时对 CoT 路径质量的评估多依赖投票，粒度粗、难以区分细微优劣，限制了奖励信号的保真度与最终性能。问题是：能否用任务无关的内部信号决定何时需要 CoT，并提供更细粒度的推理链评分？
summary.importance: 推理型应用的瓶颈之一是成本：大量样本其实可直接作答却被迫长链推理。若能可靠地“只在需要时推理”，可显著降低延迟与 FLOPs。同时，高保真奖励对训练/选择高质量推理链至关重要；投票式聚合会把不同质量的链混为一谈，削弱学习信号。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 E-GRM：基于 model-internal uncertainty 的高效 GRM 框架，包含两部分。
1) Dynamic CoT Triggering（何时 CoT）：对同一 prompt 做 M 次并行解码（使用不同采样超参，如温度/核采样阈值），观察答案收敛/一致性。直觉：简单题多次采样快速达成共识；复杂题输出分歧更大。用“共识度/一致性”指标将样本分为 short（直接/短推理）与 long（需要 CoT）两类，从而跳过简单样本的 CoT 成本。
2) Discriminative Scoring Module（如何评 CoT）：引入轻量判别式打分器，对单条推理链给出细粒度质量分。训练目标为混合损失：Huber（稳健回归，抗异常）+ hinge（排序/间隔约束，增强区分度），以同时获得稳定的标量拟合与更强的相对偏好判别能力。
整体管线：先用并行解码的一致性决定是否触发长 CoT；对生成的 CoT 候选用判别打分器进行更精细的奖励建模/选择，而非仅靠投票。
summary.experiments:
从摘要与引言可得的实验主张：
- 效率：动态触发使简单样本绕过 CoT，显著降低延迟与计算量，同时保持准确率。
- 质量：判别式细粒度评分优于投票式粗聚合，提升奖励信号保真度，进而提高最终答案准确率。
- 泛化：在多种推理任务基准上评测，展示同时“更快 + 更准”。（具体任务、指标与消融细节需结合正文实验部分核对：如触发阈值、M 的取值、不同采样策略对一致性估计的影响、以及打分器大小/训练数据来源。）
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- Methodology：
  - 不确定性/一致性度量的形式化定义（Consensus 计算、阈值策略、M 与采样超参如何设定），这是效率收益与误触发风险的核心。
  - 动态触发对端到端成本的分解：并行解码本身也有成本，需看作者如何证明“省下的 CoT 成本 > 额外并行开销”。
  - 判别打分器的训练数据构造与监督来源（来自投票伪标签、偏好对、还是外部评测器），以及 Huber+hinge 的权重与稳定性。
- Experiments：
  - 重点看效率-准确率帕累托曲线（不同阈值/不同 M）。
  - 看与投票、固定 CoT、外部难度估计器等基线对比。
  - 消融：去掉动态触发/去掉 hinge 或 Huber/替换一致性指标。
- 图表建议：Figure 1（整体框架）+ 触发比例随任务难度/阈值变化图 + 打分器对不同 CoT 链的区分案例。

skim（泛读）：
- 读 Introduction（两大痛点）+ Figure 1（框架）+ 主结果表（效率与准确率）+ 结论中对“任务无关性”的论证段落。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调“任务无关”的内部不确定性信号：不依赖外部难度分类器或手工规则，而从并行采样的收敛行为推断是否需要 CoT；并用轻量判别模型把奖励从‘投票’提升到‘细粒度链质量评分’。方法的关键风险点在于：并行解码的一致性是否稳定可靠、阈值是否跨任务可迁移，以及额外并行开销是否抵消节省的 CoT 成本。

summary_en.core_problem: Current Generative Reward Models (GRMs) often apply Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to every input, wasting compute/latency on easy prompts. They also commonly rely on voting to evaluate CoT outputs, yielding coarse reward signals that cannot finely distinguish reasoning quality. The paper asks: can we decide when CoT is needed using task-agnostic internal signals, and score reasoning chains more precisely than voting?
summary_en.importance: Efficiency is a major bottleneck for reasoning-heavy deployments: many queries are solvable with direct inference but still incur long CoT cost. Triggering CoT only when necessary can reduce FLOPs and latency. Meanwhile, high-fidelity rewards are crucial for selecting/training better reasoning; voting collapses diverse chain qualities into a blunt signal, limiting downstream gains.
summary_en.technical_approach:
E-GRM is an efficient GRM framework built on model-internal uncertainty with two components.
1) Dynamic CoT Triggering: run M parallel decodes for the same prompt under varied sampling settings (e.g., temperature/top-p). Measure answer convergence/consensus: easy prompts quickly agree across runs; hard prompts show higher variability. Use a consensus criterion to route prompts to short (direct/brief) vs long (CoT) reasoning, skipping CoT for easy cases.
2) Discriminative Scoring Module: a lightweight auxiliary scorer assigns fine-grained quality scores to individual CoT chains. It is trained with a hybrid objective: Huber loss for robust regression plus hinge loss for discriminative ranking, aiming to provide both stable scalar fitting and stronger relative preference separation.
End-to-end: uncertainty-based routing reduces unnecessary CoT, while discriminative scoring improves reward fidelity beyond voting.
summary_en.experiments:
From the abstract/introduction, the claimed findings are:
- Efficiency: dynamic triggering bypasses CoT on easy prompts, substantially reducing latency/compute without hurting accuracy.
- Fidelity/accuracy: discriminative fine-grained scoring improves reward quality over voting and boosts final answer accuracy.
- Breadth: evaluated across diverse reasoning benchmarks, showing a better speed–accuracy trade-off. (Exact datasets/metrics/ablations should be verified in the full experimental section: thresholding, choice of M, sampling strategy sensitivity, scorer size, and supervision source.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Methodology:
  - Formal definition of the consensus/uncertainty metric, thresholding, and how M and sampling hyperparameters are chosen.
  - Cost accounting: parallel decoding adds overhead—check how the paper shows net savings vs always-CoT.
  - Discriminative scorer training: data construction/supervision source and the role/weighting of Huber + hinge.
- Experiments:
  - Speed–accuracy Pareto curves across thresholds/M.
  - Comparisons to fixed CoT, voting-based GRM, and external difficulty estimators.
  - Ablations removing routing, removing hinge/Huber, or swapping the uncertainty metric.
- Figures/tables: Fig. 1 pipeline, routing rate vs difficulty/threshold, and qualitative examples where the scorer differentiates chains.

summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s stance is that task-agnostic ‘internal uncertainty’—operationalized via convergence of parallel generations—can decide when CoT is necessary, avoiding external heuristics. It further argues that a lightweight discriminative scorer can replace coarse voting with fine-grained chain evaluation. Key practical questions are the stability/transferability of the consensus threshold and whether parallel decoding overhead is consistently outweighed by saved CoT compute.

recommendation.zh: 读 §3 的“不确定性触发 CoT”规则和消融就够：若门控真稳，可直接改你们 GRM pipeline 的默认全 CoT；否则只是省算小技巧。
recommendation.en: Only §3 (uncertainty gating) + ablations matter: if the trigger is stable, it’s an actionable drop-in to stop always-CoT in GRMs; if not, it’s just a minor cost hack.
